","workspace_file_chunks":[]},{"status":"success","request_id":"2c8bc510-2218-4438-8935-c264ea588856","request_message":"","model_id":"gpt-5-1","structured_output_nodes":[{"id":1,"type":5,"content":"","tool_use":{"tool_use_id":"toolu_if9u176vttj1afz8l7j2u40v","tool_name":"view","input_json":"{"path":"springboot/src/main/java/com/example/springboot","type":"directory"}","mcp_server_name":"","mcp_tool_name":""}},{"id":3,"type":2,"content":""},{"id":4,"type":3,"content":""}],"seen_state":"unseen","structured_request_nodes":[{"id":1,"type":1,"tool_result_node":{"content":"Here's the result of running `cat -n` on springboot/SQL.sql:
 1	-- 1. 创建科室表 (department)
 2	CREATE TABLE `department` (
 3	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '科室唯一ID',
 4	 `name` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '科室名称',
 5	 `description` TEXT NULL COMMENT '科室的详细介绍',
 6	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 7	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_department_name` (`name`)
 8	) COMMENT='一级科室信息表';
 9	
 10	-- 2. 创建门诊表 (clinic)
 11	CREATE TABLE `clinic` (
 12	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '门诊唯一ID',
 13	 `department_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属科室的ID',
 14	 `name` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '门诊名称',
 15	 `description` TEXT NULL COMMENT '门诊的详细介绍',
 16	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 17	 FOREIGN KEY (`department_id`) REFERENCES `department`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 18	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_clinic_dept_name` (`department_id`, `name`)
 19	) COMMENT='二级门诊信息表';
 20	
 21	-- 3. 统一用户表 (user)
 22	CREATE TABLE `user` (
 23	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '用户唯一ID',
 24	 `username` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '登录用户名/凭证',
 25	 `password` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '加密后的密码',
 26	 `role` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '身份角色 (patient, doctor, admin)',
 27	 `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' COMMENT '账户状态 (active, inactive, pending_approval)',
 28	 `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '记录创建时间',
 29	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 30	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_user_username` (`username`)
 31	) COMMENT='统一用户登录与身份信息表';
 32	
 33	
 34	-- 4. 医生表 (doctor)
 35	CREATE TABLE `doctor` (
 36	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '医生唯一ID',
 37	 `user_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的用户ID (外键关联user表)',
 38	 `clinic_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属门诊的ID',
 39	 `name` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '医生姓名',
 40	 `title` VARCHAR(50) NULL COMMENT '医生职称',
 41	 `specialty` TEXT NULL COMMENT '擅长领域',
 42	 `bio` TEXT NULL COMMENT '个人简介',
 43	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 44	 -- 医生信息与用户账户一一对应
 45	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_doctor_user_id` (`user_id`),
 46	 FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 47	 FOREIGN KEY (`clinic_id`) REFERENCES `clinic`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
 48	) COMMENT='医生信息表';
 49	
 50	
 51	-- 5. 患者表 (patient)
 52	CREATE TABLE `patient` (
 53	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '患者唯一ID',
 54	 `user_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的用户ID (外键关联user表)',
 55	 `name` VARCHAR(50) NULL COMMENT '患者真实姓名（注册时为空，认证时填写）',
 56	 `specific_role` VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '具体角色 (student/teacher/outsider，注册时为空，认证时根据白名单确定)',
 57	 `id_status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT '身份认证状态 (pending/verified)',
 58	 `phone_number` VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '手机号码',
 59	 `id_card_number` VARCHAR(255) NULL COMMENT '身份证号 (需加密存储，认证时填写)',
 60	 `identity_number` VARCHAR(50) NULL COMMENT '学号或工号（认证时填写）',
 61	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 62	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_patient_user_id` (`user_id`),
 63	 FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 64	 INDEX `idx_patient_identity_number` (`identity_number`)
 65	) COMMENT='患者(师生)信息表';
 66	
 67	
 68	-- 6. 白名单表 (whitelist)
 69	CREATE TABLE `whitelist` (
 70	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '白名单唯一ID',
 71	 `identity_number` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '学号或工号',
 72	 `role_type` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '角色类型 (student/teacher/outsider)',
 73	 `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' COMMENT '状态 (active/inactive)',
 74	 `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
 75	 `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
 76	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 77	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_whitelist_identity_number` (`identity_number`),
 78	 INDEX `idx_whitelist_role_type` (`role_type`),
 79	 INDEX `idx_whitelist_status` (`status`)
 80	) COMMENT='身份认证白名单表（学号/工号）';
 81	
 82	-- 7. 管理员表 (admin)
 83	CREATE TABLE `admin` (
 84	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '管理员唯一ID',
 85	 `user_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的用户ID (外键关联user表)',
 86	 `name` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '管理员姓名',
 87	 `admin_role` VARCHAR(30) NULL COMMENT '管理员具体角色 (如：超级管理员)',
 88	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 89	 -- 管理员信息与用户账户一一对应
 90	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_admin_user_id` (`user_id`),
 91	 FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
 92	) COMMENT='管理员信息表';
 93	
 94	-- 8. 创建排班表 (schedule)
 95	CREATE TABLE `schedule` (
 96	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '排班唯一ID',
 97	 `doctor_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '医生ID',
 98	 `schedule_date` DATE NOT NULL COMMENT '出诊日期',
 99	 `time_slot` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '时间段 (morning/afternoon)',
 100	 `slot_type` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' COMMENT '号别 (normal, expert, vip)',
 101	 `total_slots` INT NOT NULL COMMENT '总号源数',
 102	 `available_slots` INT NOT NULL COMMENT '剩余号源数',
 103	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 104	 -- 外键引用已更新为 doctor
 105	 FOREIGN KEY (`doctor_id`) REFERENCES `doctor`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 106	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_doctor_schedule` (`doctor_id`, `schedule_date`, `time_slot`) -- 一个医生在一个时间段只能有一个排班
 107	) COMMENT='医生排班表';
 108	
 109	-- 9. 创建预约记录表 (appointment)
 110	CREATE TABLE `appointment` (
 111	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '预约唯一ID',
 112	 `patient_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '患者ID (外键关联patient表)',
 113	 `doctor_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '医生ID',
 114	 `schedule_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '排班ID',
 115	 `appointment_time` DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '预约成功后确定的就诊时间',
 116	 `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled' COMMENT '状态 (scheduled/cancelled/completed)',
 117	 `fee` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '原始挂号费',
 118	 `actual_fee` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '根据角色报销后的实际支付费用',
 119	 `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '记录创建时间',
 120	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 121	 -- 外键引用已更新为 patient, doctor, schedule
 122	 FOREIGN KEY (`patient_id`) REFERENCES `patient`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 123	 FOREIGN KEY (`doctor_id`) REFERENCES `doctor`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 124	 FOREIGN KEY (`schedule_id`) REFERENCES `schedule`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
 125	) COMMENT='预约记录表';
 126	
 127	-- 10. 创建候补队列表 (waitlist)
 128	CREATE TABLE `waitlist` (
 129	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '候补记录唯一ID',
 130	 `schedule_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '目标排班ID',
 131	 `patient_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '候补的患者ID',
 132	 `join_time` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '加入候补队列的时间 (用于确定优先级)',
 133	 `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'WAITING' COMMENT '候补状态 (WAITING, NOTIFIED, GRANTED, EXPIRED)',
 134	
 135	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 136	
 137	 -- 确保一个患者不能为同一个排班重复加入候补
 138	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_waitlist_unique` (`schedule_id`, `patient_id`),
 139	
 140	 -- 外键关联到排班表 (schedule)
 141	 FOREIGN KEY (`schedule_id`) REFERENCES `schedule`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 142	 -- 外键关联到患者表 (patient)
 143	 FOREIGN KEY (`patient_id`) REFERENCES `patient`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
 144	) COMMENT='预约候补队列记录表';
 145	
 146	-- 11. 创建系统配置与规则表 (system_config)
 147	CREATE TABLE `system_config` (
 148	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '配置唯一ID',
 149	 `key` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '配置项键名 (如：STUDENT_REIMBURSEMENT_RATE)',
 150	 `value` VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL COMMENT '配置项值',
 151	 `description` VARCHAR(255) NULL COMMENT '配置项描述',
 152	 `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
 153	 `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '最后更新时间',
 154	
 155	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 156	 -- 配置键名必须唯一
 157	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_config_key` (`key`)
 158	) COMMENT='系统全局配置与规则表';
 159	
 160	-- 12. 创建预支付订单表 (prepayment_order)
 161	CREATE TABLE `prepayment_order` (
 162	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '预支付订单唯一ID',
 163	 `order_no` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '订单号（唯一）',
 164	 `patient_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '患者ID',
 165	 `schedule_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '排班ID',
 166	 `waitlist_id` BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '候补记录ID',
 167	 `order_type` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'WAITLIST' COMMENT '订单类型 (WAITLIST-候补预支付)',
 168	 `original_fee` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '原始挂号费',
 169	 `actual_fee` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '实际支付费用（报销后）',
 170	 `paid_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '已支付金额',
 171	 `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' COMMENT '订单状态 (PENDING-待支付, PAID-已支付, REFUNDED-已退款, CONSUMED-已消费, EXPIRED-已过期)',
 172	 `payment_method` VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '支付方式 (ALIPAY, WECHAT, BALANCE等)',
 173	 `payment_time` DATETIME NULL COMMENT '支付时间',
 174	 `refund_time` DATETIME NULL COMMENT '退款时间',
 175	 `refund_reason` VARCHAR(255) NULL COMMENT '退款原因',
 176	 `expire_time` DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '订单过期时间',
 177	 `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
 178	 `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
 179	
 180	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 181	 UNIQUE KEY `uk_order_no` (`order_no`),
 182	 FOREIGN KEY (`patient_id`) REFERENCES `patient`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 183	 FOREIGN KEY (`schedule_id`) REFERENCES `schedule`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 184	 FOREIGN KEY (`waitlist_id`) REFERENCES `waitlist`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 185	 INDEX `idx_patient_status` (`patient_id`, `status`),
 186	 INDEX `idx_waitlist_status` (`waitlist_id`, `status`),
 187	 INDEX `idx_expire_time` (`expire_time`)
 188	) COMMENT='候补预支付订单表';
 189	
 190	-- 12. 插入系统配置初始数据
 191	INSERT INTO `system_config` (`key`, `value`, `description`) VALUES
 192	('STUDENT_REIMBURSEMENT_RATE', '0.95', '学生挂号费报销比例'),
 193	('TEACHER_REIMBURSEMENT_RATE', '0.90', '教师挂号费报销比例'),
 194	('CANCELLATION_FREE_HOURS', '24', '就诊前多久取消可免费退号，否则记录爽约（单位：小时）');
 195	
 196	-- 13. 为预约表添加来源类型字段
 197	ALTER TABLE `appointment` ADD COLUMN `source_type` VARCHAR(20) COMMENT '预约来源类型';
 198	
 199	-- ========================================
 200	-- 14. 排班规则表 (schedule_rule)
 201	-- ========================================
 202	CREATE TABLE `schedule_rule` (
 203	 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '规则唯一ID',
 204	 `rule_name` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '规则名称',
 205	 `rule_type` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '规则类型 (weekly/custom/template)',
 206	 `doctor_id` BIGINT NULL COMMENT '关联医生ID (可为空表示科室规则)',
 207	 `department_id` BIGINT NULL COMMENT '关联科室ID',
 208	 `clinic_id` BIGINT NULL COMMENT '关联门诊ID',
 209	 
 210	 -- 时间相关配置
 211	 `week_days` VARCHAR(50) NULL COMMENT '星期配置 (如: 1,3,5 表示周一三五)',

 38	 // 患者的候补列表 (SET): "waitlist:patient:{patientId}" -> SET [ "scheduleId1", "scheduleId2" ]
 39	 private static final String PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX = "waitlist:patient:";
 40	
 41	
 42	 /** [重构] 加入候补队列 (使用 Redis ZSET) */
 43	 public void addToQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 44	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 45	 if (schedule == null) {
 46	 throw new CustomerException("排班不存在");
 47	 }
 48	 if (schedule.getAvailableSlots() != null && schedule.getAvailableSlots() > 0) {
 49	 throw new CustomerException("当前仍有号源，可直接预约");
 50	 }
 51	
 52	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 53	
 54	 // 检查是否已在队列中 (score不为null说明已存在)
 55	 Double score = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().score(key, patientId);
 56	 if (score != null) {
 57	 throw new CustomerException("已在候补队列中，请勿重复提交");
 58	 }
 59	
 60	 // 1. 加入 ZSET，分数为当前时间戳
 61	 long joinTime = new Date().getTime();
 62	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().add(key, patientId, (double) joinTime);
 63	
 64	 // 2. 额外维护一个反向索引 (用于 "我的候补" 查询)
 65	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 66	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().add(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 67	 }
 68	
 69	 /** [重构] 弹出队首 (从 ZSET 中弹出分数最低的) */
 70	 public Long popNext(Long scheduleId) {
 71	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 72	
 73	 // 弹出分数最低（即最早加入）的 1 个元素
 74	 // 注意: popMin 返回一个包含 TypedTuple 的 Set，我们需要从中提取值
 75	 Set<Object> result = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().popMin(key, 1)
 76	 .stream()
 77	 .map(tuple -> ((org.springframework.data.redis.core.ZSetOperations.TypedTuple<Object>) tuple).getValue())
 78	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 79	
 80	 if (result.isEmpty()) {
 81	 return null; // 队列为空
 82	 }
 83	
 84	 // (注意: 序列化配置会导致这里可能是Integer或String)
 85	 // 确保使用 Long 类型
 86	 Long patientId = ((Number) result.iterator().next()).longValue();
 87	
 88	 // 3. (清理) 从该患者的反向索引中移除这个排班
 89	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 90	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 91	
 92	 return patientId;
 93	 }
 94	
 95	 /** [重构] 根据患者ID查询候补列表 */
 96	 public List<WaitlistInfoDTO> listByPatient(Long patientId) {
 97	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 98	
 99	 // 1. 获取该患者候补的所有 scheduleId
 100	 Set<Object> scheduleIdObjects = redisTemplate.opsForSet().members(patientKey);
 101	 if (scheduleIdObjects == null || scheduleIdObjects.isEmpty()) {
 102	 return List.of(); // 返回空列表
 103	 }
 104	
 105	 // 2. 遍历，查询每个队列中该 patientId 的排名，并补充展示所需信息
 106	 return scheduleIdObjects.stream()
 107	 .map(obj -> {
 108	 if (!(obj instanceof Number) && !(obj instanceof String)) {
 109	 return null;
 110	 }
 111	 try {
 112	 Long scheduleId = Long.valueOf(String.valueOf(obj));
 113	 String queueKey = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 114	
 115	 Long rank = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().rank(queueKey, patientId);
 116	 Long queueSize = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().size(queueKey);
 117	 if (rank == null) {
 118	 return null;
 119	 }
 120	
 121	 WaitlistInfoDTO dto = new WaitlistInfoDTO(scheduleId, rank, queueSize);
 122	
 123	 // 额外补充：医生与排班信息
 124	 Schedule s = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 125	 if (s != null) {
 126	 dto.setScheduleDate(s.getScheduleDate());
 127	 dto.setTimeSlot(s.getTimeSlot());
 128	 dto.setTimeSlotName(timeSlotToCn(s.getTimeSlot()));
 129	 dto.setDoctorId(s.getDoctorId());
 130	 try {
 131	 Doctor d = doctorMapper.selectById(s.getDoctorId());
 132	 if (d != null) dto.setDoctorName(d.getName());
 133	 } catch (Exception ignored) {}
 134	 }
 135	 return dto;
 136	 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
 137	 System.err.println("Invalid scheduleId format in Redis set: " + obj);
 138	 return null;
 139	 }
 140	 })
 141	 .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull)
 142	 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 143	 }
 144	
 145	 /** [新增] 从候补队列中移除 */
 146	 public void removeFromQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 147	 String queueKey = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 148	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 149	 // 1. 从 ZSET 中移除患者
 150	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().remove(queueKey, patientId);
 151	 // 2. 从患者的反向索引 SET 中移除 scheduleId
 152	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 153	 }
 154	
 155	 private String timeSlotToCn(String timeSlot) {
 156	 if (timeSlot == null) return null;
 157	 switch (timeSlot.toLowerCase()) {
 158	 case "morning": return "上午";
 159	 case "afternoon": return "下午";
 160	 case "evening": return "晚上";
 161	 default: return timeSlot;
 162	 }
 163	 }
 164	
 165	}

 53	 @Transactional

 55	 // 1. 检查候补记录是否存在
 56	 Waitlist waitlist = waitlistMapper.selectById(waitlistId);
 57	 if (waitlist == null) {
 58	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录不存在");
 59	 }

 61	 // 2. 检查患者ID是否匹配
 62	 if (!waitlist.getPatientId().equals(patientId)) {
 63	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录与患者不匹配");
 64	 }
 65	 
 66	 // 3. 检查排班ID是否匹配
 67	 if (!waitlist.getScheduleId().equals(scheduleId)) {

 69	 }

 71	 // 4. 检查是否已经存在预支付订单
 72	 PrepaymentOrder existingOrder = prepaymentOrderMapper.selectByWaitlistId(waitlistId);
 73	 if (existingOrder != null) {
 74	 // 如果订单已过期，则可以重新创建
 75	 if ("EXPIRED".equals(existingOrder.getStatus())) {

 88	 // 6. 计算原始费用和实际费用
 89	 BigDecimal originalFee = calculateOriginalFee(schedule.getSlotType());
 90	 BigDecimal actualFee = calculateActualFee(patientId, originalFee);

 92	 // 7. 生成订单号

 94

 96	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 97	 calendar.add(Calendar.MINUTE, 30);
 98	 Date expireTime = calendar.getTime();

 112	 order.setCreatedAt(new Date());
 113	 order.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
 114	 
 115	 // 10. 保存订单
 116	 prepaymentOrderMapper.insert(order);

 118	 return order;

 137	 if (!"PENDING".equals(order.getStatus())) {
 138	 throw new CustomerException("订单状态不正确，无法支付");

 142	 if (order.getExpireTime().before(new Date())) {

 145	 throw new CustomerException("订单已过期，请重新创建");

 149	 if (paidAmount.compareTo(order.getActualFee()) < 0) {
 150	 throw new CustomerException("支付金额不足");
 151	 }

 153	 // 5. 更新订单状态和支付信息
 154	 prepaymentOrderMapper.updatePaymentInfo(

 156	 "PAID",
 157	 paymentMethod,
 158	 new Date(),
 159	 paidAmount

 242	 refundOrder(order.getOrderNo(), "候补失败或取消，系统自动退款");
 243	 logger.info("订单已退款: {}", order.getOrderNo());
 244	 } catch (Exception e) {

 246	 }

 250	 /**
 251	 * 根据排班类型计算原始费用
 252	 */
 253	 private BigDecimal calculateOriginalFee(String slotType) {
 254	 String normalized = slotType == null ? "NORMAL" : slotType.trim().toUpperCase();
 255	 String key;
 256	 switch (normalized) {
 257	 case "EXPERT":
 258	 key = "FEE_EXPERT";
 259	 break;
 260	 case "VIP":
 261	 key = "FEE_VIP";
 262	 break;
 263	 default:
 264	 key = "FEE_NORMAL";
 265	 }
 266	 return systemConfigService.getDecimalOrDefault(key, new BigDecimal("0.00"));
 267	 }

 269	 /**
 270	 * 根据患者身份计算实际支付费用
 271	 */
 272	 private BigDecimal calculateActualFee(Long patientId, BigDecimal originalFee) {
 273	 try {
 274	 Patient patient = patientMapper.selectById(patientId);
 275	 if (patient == null) {
 276	 return originalFee;
 277	 }
 278	 
 279	 String specificRole = patient.getSpecificRole();
 280	 if (specificRole == null || !"verified".equals(patient.getIdStatus())) {
 281	 // 未认证或无身份信息，不享受报销
 282	 return originalFee;
 283	 }
 284	 
 285	 // 根据身份类型计算报销后的实际费用
 286	 if ("student".equals(specificRole)) {
 287	 // 学生报销95%，实付5%
 288	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.05"));
 289	 } else if ("teacher".equals(specificRole)) {
 290	 // 教师报销90%，实付10%
 291	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.10"));
 292	 }
 293	 
 294	 return originalFee;
 295	 } catch (Exception e) {
 296	 logger.warn("计算实际费用失败: {}", e.getMessage());
 297	 return originalFee;
 298	 }
 299	 }

 29	 public List<ScheduleDTO> getWeekSchedule() {
 30	 // 获取当前日期
 31	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 32	 calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
 33	 calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
 34	 calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
 35	 calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
 36	 Date startDate = calendar.getTime();
 37	
 38	 // 获取一周后的日期
 39	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 7);
 40	 Date endDate = calendar.getTime();
 41	
 42	 // 查询数据库
 43	 List<Schedule> schedules = scheduleMapper.selectSchedulesByDateRange(startDate, endDate);
 44	
 45	 // 转换为DTO并添加星期几信息
 46	 List<ScheduleDTO> scheduleDTOs = new ArrayList<>();
 47	 for (Schedule schedule : schedules) {
 48	 ScheduleDTO dto = new ScheduleDTO();
 49	 BeanUtils.copyProperties(schedule, dto);
 50	
 51	 // 获取星期几
 52	 calendar.setTime(schedule.getScheduleDate());
 53	 int dayOfWeek = calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK) - 1;
 54	 dto.setDayOfWeek(DAYS_OF_WEEK[dayOfWeek]);
 55	
 56	 scheduleDTOs.add(dto);
 57	 }
 58	
 59	 return scheduleDTOs;
 60	 }

 64	 /**
 65	 * 创建单个排班
 66	 */
 67	 @Transactional
 68	 public Schedule createSchedule(CreateScheduleRequest request) {
 69	 // 1. 验证医生是否存在
 70	 if (doctorMapper.selectById(request.getDoctorId()) == null) {
 71	 throw new RuntimeException("医生不存在");
 72	 }
 73	
 74	 // 2. 检查是否已存在相同的排班
 75	 int exists = scheduleMapper.checkScheduleExists(
 76	 request.getDoctorId(),
 77	 request.getScheduleDate(),
 78	 request.getTimeSlot()
 79	 );
 80	 if (exists > 0) {
 81	 throw new RuntimeException("该时间段已存在排班，请勿重复创建");
 82	 }
 83	
 84	 // 3. 创建排班记录
 85	 Schedule schedule = new Schedule();
 86	 schedule.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
 87	 schedule.setScheduleDate(request.getScheduleDate());
 88	 schedule.setTimeSlot(request.getTimeSlot());
 89	 schedule.setSlotType(request.getSlotType());
 90	 schedule.setTotalSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 91	
 92	 // 如果没有指定可用号源数，则默认等于总号源数
 93	 if (request.getAvailableSlots() != null) {
 94	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getAvailableSlots());
 95	 } else {
 96	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 97	 }
 98	
 99	 scheduleMapper.insert(schedule);
 100	 return schedule;
 101	 }

 103	 /**
 104	 * 批量创建排班
 105	 */
 106	 @Transactional
 107	 public Map<String, Object> batchCreateSchedule(BatchScheduleRequest request) {
 108	 // 1. 验证医生是否存在
 109	 if (doctorMapper.selectById(request.getDoctorId()) == null) {
 110	 throw new RuntimeException("医生不存在");
 111	 }
 112	
 113	 // 2. 验证日期范围
 114	 if (request.getEndDate().before(request.getStartDate())) {
 115	 throw new RuntimeException("结束日期不能早于开始日期");
 116	 }
 117	
 118	 // 3. 生成日期列表
 119	 List<Date> dateList = generateDateList(
 120	 request.getStartDate(),
 121	 request.getEndDate(),
 122	 request.getSkipWeekends(),
 123	 request.getExcludeDates()
 124	 );
 125	
 126	 // 4. 批量创建排班
 127	 int successCount = 0;
 128	 int skipCount = 0;
 129	 List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();
 130	
 131	 for (Date date : dateList) {
 132	 for (String timeSlot : request.getTimeSlots()) {
 133	 try {
 134	 // 检查是否已存在
 135	 int exists = scheduleMapper.checkScheduleExists(
 136	 request.getDoctorId(), date, timeSlot
 137	 );
 138	 if (exists > 0) {
 139	 skipCount++;
 140	 continue;
 141	 }
 142	
 143	 // 创建排班
 144	 Schedule schedule = new Schedule();
 145	 schedule.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
 146	 schedule.setScheduleDate(date);
 147	 schedule.setTimeSlot(timeSlot);
 148	 schedule.setSlotType(request.getSlotType());
 149	 schedule.setTotalSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 150	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 151	
 152	 scheduleMapper.insert(schedule);
 153	 successCount++;
 154	 } catch (Exception e) {
 155	 errors.add(String.format("日期 %s 时段 %s 创建失败: %s", date, timeSlot, e.getMessage()));
 156	 }
 157	 }
 158	 }
 159	
 160	 // 5. 返回结果
 161	 Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
 162	 result.put("successCount", successCount);
 163	 result.put("skipCount", skipCount);
 164	 result.put("errorCount", errors.size());
 165	 result.put("errors", errors);
 166	 result.put("message", String.format("成功创建 %d 个排班，跳过 %d 个已存在的排班", successCount, skipCount));
 167	
 168	 return result;
 169	 }

 315	 private List<Date> generateDateList(Date startDate, Date endDate, Boolean skipWeekends, List<Date> excludeDates) {
 316	 List<Date> dateList = new ArrayList<>();
 317	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 318	 calendar.setTime(startDate);
 319	 calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
 320	 calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
 321	 calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
 322	 calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
 323	
 324	 while (!calendar.getTime().after(endDate)) {
 325	 Date currentDate = calendar.getTime();
 326	
 327	 // 检查是否需要跳过周末
 328	 if (skipWeekends != null && skipWeekends) {
 329	 int dayOfWeek = calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 330	 if (dayOfWeek == Calendar.SATURDAY || dayOfWeek == Calendar.SUNDAY) {
 331	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 332	 continue;
 333	 }
 334	 }
 335	
 336	 // 检查是否在排除日期中
 337	 boolean isExcluded = false;
 338	 if (excludeDates != null) {
 339	 for (Date excludeDate : excludeDates) {
 340	 Calendar excludeCal = Calendar.getInstance();
 341	 excludeCal.setTime(excludeDate);
 342	 if (calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.YEAR) &&
 343	 calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR)) {
 344	 isExcluded = true;
 345	 break;
 346	 }
 347	 }
 348	 }
 349	
 350	 if (!isExcluded) {
 351	 dateList.add(currentDate);
 352	 }
 353	
 354	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 355	 }
 356	
 357	 return dateList;
 358	 }

 70	 Date dayEnd = atStartOfNextDay(schedule.getScheduleDate());

 72	 throw new CustomerException("预约时间与排班日期不一致");
 73	 }
 74	
 75	 // 每个患者每天最多预约N次（默认3）
 76	 Long patientId = appointment.getPatientId();
 77	 int dailyLimit = systemConfigService.getIntOrDefault("APPOINTMENT_DAILY_LIMIT", 3);
 78	 int todayCount = appointmentMapper.countByPatientAndDate(patientId, dayStart, dayEnd);

 84	 int exists = appointmentMapper.existsByPatientAndSchedule(patientId, appointment.getScheduleId());
 85	 if (exists > 0) {

 87	 }

 296	 // 检查是否为本人（比较 userId）
 297	 if (!currentUserId.equals(patient.getUserId())) {
 298	 logger.warn("用户 {} 尝试取消预约 {}，但该预约属于用户 {}",
 299	 currentUserId, id, patient.getUserId());
 300	 throw new CustomerException("403", "无权限取消其他患者的预约");
 301	 }
 302	 }
 303	
 304	 // 退号时限：就诊前2小时内不可退号（可通过配置覆盖）
 305	 int cancelLimitMinutes = systemConfigService.getIntOrDefault("CANCEL_LIMIT_MINUTES", 120);
 306	 Date now = new Date();
 307	
 308	 // [修复] 确保 appointmentTime 不为 null
 309	 if (appointment.getAppointmentTime() == null) {
 310	 logger.warn("预约 {} 的 appointmentTime 为 null，跳过退号时限检查", id);
 311	 } else {
 312	 long diffMillis = appointment.getAppointmentTime().getTime() - now.getTime();
 313	 long remainMinutes = diffMillis / (60 * 1000);
 314	 if (remainMinutes < cancelLimitMinutes) {
 315	 throw new CustomerException("距离就诊不足" + cancelLimitMinutes + "分钟，不可退号");
 316	 }
 317	 }
 318	
 319	 int result = appointmentMapper.updateStatus(id, "cancelled");
 320	
 321	 // 如果取消成功，尝试从候补队列中弹出下一个患者并创建预约；若无候补则归还号源
 322	 if (result > 0) {
 323	 boolean filled = processNextInWaitlist(appointment.getScheduleId());
 324	 if (!filled) {
 325	 try {
 326	 scheduleMapper.increaseAvailableSlots(appointment.getScheduleId());
 327	 } catch (Exception e) {
 328	 logger.warn("归还号源失败: {}", e.getMessage());
 329	 }
 330	 }
 331	 }
 332	
 333	 return result;
 334	 }

 369	 /**

 371	 */
 372	 private BigDecimal calculateActualFee(Long patientId, BigDecimal originalFee) {
 373	 try {
 374	 Patient patient = patientMapper.selectById(patientId);
 375	 if (patient == null) {
 376	 return originalFee;
 377	 }
 378	 
 379	 String specificRole = patient.getSpecificRole();
 380	 if (specificRole == null || !"verified".equals(patient.getIdStatus())) {
 381	 // 未认证或无身份信息，不享受报销
 382	 return originalFee;
 383	 }
 384	 
 385	 // 根据身份类型计算报销后的实际费用
 386	 if ("student".equals(specificRole)) {
 387	 // 学生报锅95%，实付5%
 388	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.05"));
 389	 } else if ("teacher".equals(specificRole)) {
 390	 // 教师报锅90%，实付10%
 391	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.10"));
 392	 }
 393	 
 394	 return originalFee;
 395	 } catch (Exception e) {
 396	 logger.warn("计算实际费用失败: {}", e.getMessage());
 397	 return originalFee;
 398	 }
 399	 }

 227							this.waitlistInfo.rank = currentWaitlist.rank;
 228							this.waitlistInfo.queueSize = currentWaitlist.queueSize;
 229						}

 232					// 检测候补状态变化
 233					await this.checkWaitlistSuccess(currentWaitlist);
 234	
 235					// 通过排班ID获取详细信息（包含医生、科室等）
 236					if (this.scheduleId) {
 237						try {
 238							const scheduleDetails = await getScheduleDetailsById(this.scheduleId);
 239							console.log('排班详细信息:', scheduleDetails);
 240	
 241							if (scheduleDetails) {
 242								// 设置医生信息
 243								this.doctorInfo.id = scheduleDetails.doctorId;
 244								this.doctorInfo.name = scheduleDetails.doctorName || '未知医生';
 245								this.doctorInfo.title = ''; // 排班信息中没有职称，需要时可以额外查询

 249								this.scheduleInfo.date = this.formatDate(scheduleDetails.scheduleDate);
 250								this.scheduleInfo.timeSlot = scheduleDetails.timeSlot;
 251	
 252								// 设置时间段显示文本
 253								const timeSlotMap = {
 254									'morning': '上午',
 255									'afternoon': '下午',
 256									'evening': '晚上'
 257								};
 258								const lowerCaseTimeSlot = scheduleDetails.timeSlot ? scheduleDetails.timeSlot.toLowerCase() : '';
 259								this.scheduleInfo.timeSlotDisplay = timeSlotMap[lowerCaseTimeSlot] || scheduleDetails.timeSlot;
 260							}
 261						} catch (e) {
 262							console.error('获取排班详细信息失败:', e);
 263							// 如果获取失败，保留原有的参数信息
 264						}
 265					}
 266				} catch (e) {
 267					console.error('加载候补信息失败:', e);
 268					uni.showToast({

 272				} finally {

 274						this.loading = false;

 276				}

 279			// 检测候补状态变化
 280			async checkWaitlistSuccess(currentWaitlist) {
 281				// 记录当前候补状态
 282				const currentStatus = currentWaitlist ? 'waiting' : 'none';
 283	
 284				// 第一次检测，只记录状态
 285				if (this.lastWaitlistStatus === null) {
 286					this.lastWaitlistStatus = currentStatus;
 287					console.log('初始化候补状态:', currentStatus);
 288	
 289					// 如果有候补记录，启动预约检查定时器
 290					if (currentWaitlist) {
 291						this.startAppointmentCheck();
 292					}
 293					return;
 294				}
 295	
 296				// 检测候补记录消失
 297				if (this.lastWaitlistStatus === 'waiting' && currentStatus === 'none') {
 298					console.log('检测到候补记录消失');
 299	
 300					// 停止所有定时器
 301					this.stopAllTimers();
 302	
 303					// 检查是否有新预约
 304					const hasAppointment = await this.checkForNewAppointment();
 305	
 306					if (hasAppointment) {
 307						console.log('✅ 候补成功！已找到新预约');
 308						this.handleWaitlistSuccess();
 309					} else {
 310						console.log('❌ 候补记录消失但未找到新预约（可能是手动退出）');
 311						// 返回上一页
 312						setTimeout(() => {
 313							uni.navigateBack();
 314						}, 1000);
 315					}
 316				}
 317	
 318				// 更新状态
 319				this.lastWaitlistStatus = currentStatus;

 322			// 启动预约检查定时器
 323			startAppointmentCheck() {
 324				console.log('启动预约检查定时器，每', this.checkInterval / 1000, '秒检查一次');
 325	
 326				// 清除旧的定时器
 327				if (this.checkAppointmentTimer) {
 328					clearInterval(this.checkAppointmentTimer);
 329				}
 330	
 331				// 启动新的定时器
 332				this.checkAppointmentTimer = setInterval(async () => {
 333					this.currentCheckCount++;
 334					console.log(`第 ${this.currentCheckCount} 次检查预约...`);
 335	
 336					// 达到最大检查次数
 337					if (this.currentCheckCount >= this.maxCheckCount) {
 338						console.log('达到最大检查次数，停止检查');
 339						this.stopAllTimers();
 340						return;
 341					}
 342	
 343					// 检查是否有新预约
 344					const hasAppointment = await this.checkForNewAppointment();
 345					if (hasAppointment) {
 346						console.log('✅ 检测到新预约！候补成功');
 347						this.stopAllTimers();
 348						this.handleWaitlistSuccess();
 349					}
 350				}, this.checkInterval);

 353			// 检查是否有新预约
 354			async checkForNewAppointment() {
 355				try {
 356					const data = await request({ url: '/appointment/me', method: 'GET', silent: true });
 357					const appointments = Array.isArray(data) ? data : ((data && data.list) ? data.list : []);
 358	
 359					console.log('当前预约列表:', appointments);
 360	
 361					// 查找匹配的预约：scheduleId匹配 且 来源是候补
 362					const newAppointment = appointments.find(apt => {
 363						const match = apt.scheduleId === this.scheduleId && apt.sourceType === 'WAITLIST';
 364						if (match) {
 365							console.log('找到匹配的预约:', apt);
 366						}
 367						return match;
 368					});
 369	
 370					return !!newAppointment;
 371				} catch (err) {
 372					console.error('检查预约失败:', err);
 373					return false;
 374				}

 521			formatDate(dateStr) {
 522				if (!dateStr) return '';
 523				const date = new Date(dateStr);
 524				const year = date.getFullYear();
 525				const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
 526				const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
 527				return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;

 55	 @Operation(summary = "根据ID查询预约", description = "通过预约ID获取预约详情")
 56	 @GetMapping("/selectById/{id}")
 57	 @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'PATIENT', 'DOCTOR')")
 58	 public Result selectById(
 59	 @Parameter(description = "预约ID", required = true) @PathVariable Long id) {
 60	 Appointment appointment = appointmentService.selectById(id);
 61	 if (appointment == null) {
 62	 return Result.error("预约不存在");
 63	 }
 64	
 65	 // 管理员可直接查看
 66	 if (SecurityUtils.isAdmin()) {
 67	 return Result.success(appointment);
 68	 }
 69	
 70	 Long currentUserId = SecurityUtils.getCurrentUserId();
 71	
 72	 // 患者仅能查看本人预约
 73	 if (SecurityUtils.isPatient()) {
 74	 if (!appointment.getPatientId().equals(currentUserId)) {
 75	 return Result.error("无权限查看该预约");
 76	 }
 77	 return Result.success(appointment);
 78	 }
 79	
 80	 // 医生仅能查看自己名下预约
 81	 if (SecurityUtils.isDoctor()) {
 82	 Doctor currentDoctor = doctorMapper.selectByUserId(currentUserId);
 83	 if (currentDoctor == null) {
 84	 return Result.error("当前医生信息不存在");
 85	 }
 86	 if (!appointment.getDoctorId().equals(currentDoctor.getId())) {
 87	 return Result.error("无权限查看非本人名下预约");
 88	 }
 89	 return Result.success(appointment);
 90	 }
 91	
 92	 return Result.error("无权限");
 93	 }

 126

 128	 appointment.setStatus("scheduled");
 129	 appointment.setSourceType("ONLINE");
 130	 appointment.setCreatedAt(new java.util.Date());
 131	
 132	 try {
 133	 // 6. [修复] 调用 Service (Service 负责扣减号源)

 85					{{ isScheduleFull ? '号源已满' : (submitting ? '提交中...' : '确认支付') }}
 86				</button>
 87			</view>
 88			
 89			<!-- 号源已满提示 -->
 90			<view class="full-schedule-popup" v-if="isScheduleFull">
 91				<view class="popup-content">
 92					<text class="popup-icon">⏰</text>
 93					<text class="popup-title">号源已满</text>
 94					<text class="popup-desc">该时段号源已满，您可以加入候补队列，当有号源释放时系统将自动为您预约</text>
 95					<view class="popup-actions">
 96						<button class="cancel-btn" @click="goBack">返回</button>
 97						<button class="waitlist-btn" @click="joinWaitlist">加入候补</button>
 98					</view>
 99				</view>
 100			</view>
 101		</view>
 102	</template>
 103	
 104	<script>
 105	import { getDoctorById } from '@/api/doctor.js'
 106	import { createAppointment } from '@/api/appointment.js'
 107	import { getPatientProfile } from '@/api/patient.js'
 108	import { getScheduleById } from '@/api/schedule.js'
 109	import { joinWaitlist } from '@/api/waitlist.js'
 110	
 111	export default {
 112		name: 'OrderConfirm',
 113		data() {
 114			return {
 115				doctorId: null,
 116				scheduleId: null,
 117				doctorInfo: {},
 118				patientInfo: {
 119					name: '',
 120					specificRole: '',
 121					idStatus: ''
 122				},
 123				schedule: {
 124					id: null,
 125					scheduleDate: '',
 126					timeSlot: '',
 127					startTime: '08:00',
 128					endTime: '12:00',
 129					fee: null,
 130					availableSlots: 1 // 默认有号源
 131				},
 132				submitting: false,
 133				loading: false,
 134				isScheduleFull: false // 标记号源是否已满
 135			};
 136		},
 137		computed: {
 138			// 获取用户信息
 139			userInfo() {
 140				return this.$store.state.user.userInfo || {};
 141			},
 142			
 143			// 是否已认证身份
 144			isIdentityVerified() {
 145				const idStatus = this.patientInfo.idStatus || '';
 146				return idStatus === 'verified' || idStatus === '已认证';
 147			},
 148			
 149			// 身份类型文本
 150			identityTypeText() {
 151				const type = this.patientInfo.specificRole || '';
 152				if (type === 'student') return '学生';
 153				if (type === 'teacher') return '教师';
 154				if (type === 'outsider') return '外部人员';
 155				return type || '普通患者';
 156			},
 157			
 158			// 认证状态样式类
 159			identityStatusClass() {
 160				return this.isIdentityVerified ? 'verified' : 'not-verified-status';
 161			},
 162			
 163			// 认证状态图标
 164			identityStatusIcon() {
 165				return this.isIdentityVerified ? '✅' : '⚠️';
 166			},
 167			
 168			// 认证状态文本
 169			identityStatusText() {
 170				return this.isIdentityVerified ? '已认证' : '未认证';
 171			},
 172			
 173			// 报销比例
 174			reimbursementRate() {
 175				if (!this.isIdentityVerified) return 0;
 176				const type = this.patientInfo.specificRole;
 177				if (type === 'student') return 95; // 学生报销95%
 178				if (type === 'teacher') return 90; // 教师报销90%
 179				return 0;
 180			},
 181			
 182			// 原价
 183			originalFee() {
 184				const fee = this.schedule.fee || this.estimateFee();
 185				return Number(fee).toFixed(2);
 186			},
 187			
 188			// 报销金额
 189			reimbursementAmount() {
 190				const amount = (Number(this.originalFee) * this.reimbursementRate / 100);
 191				return amount.toFixed(2);
 192			},
 193			
 194			// 实付金额
 195			actualFee() {
 196				const actual = Number(this.originalFee) - Number(this.reimbursementAmount);
 197				return actual.toFixed(2);
 198			}
 199		},
 200		onLoad(options) {
 201			this.doctorId = Number(options.doctorId || 0);
 202			this.scheduleId = Number(options.scheduleId || 0);
 203			this.schedule.id = this.scheduleId;
 204	
 205			this.loadData();
 206		},
 207		methods: {
 208			// 加载所有数据
 209			async loadData() {
 210				this.loading = true;
 211				try {
 212					// 加载排班信息（必须先加载，因为需要获取日期和时间）
 213					await this.loadSchedule();
 214					// 加载医生信息
 215					await this.loadDoctor();
 216					// 加载患者信息
 217					await this.loadPatientInfo();
 218				} catch (e) {
 219					console.error('加载数据失败:', e);
 220				} finally {
 221					this.loading = false;
 222				}
 223			},
 224			
 225			// 加载排班信息
 226			async loadSchedule() {
 227				try {
 228					if (!this.scheduleId) return;
 229					const data = await getScheduleById(this.scheduleId);
 230					console.log('获取到的排班信息:', data); // 调试日志
 231					
 232					if (data) {
 233						// 根据时段设置默认开始时间
 234						let defaultStartTime = '08:00';
 235						let defaultEndTime = '12:00';
 236						
 237						if (data.timeSlot === 'morning' || data.timeSlot === '上午') {
 238							defaultStartTime = '08:00';
 239							defaultEndTime = '12:00';
 240						} else if (data.timeSlot === 'afternoon' || data.timeSlot === '下午') {
 241							defaultStartTime = '14:00';
 242							defaultEndTime = '18:00';
 243						} else if (data.timeSlot === 'evening' || data.timeSlot === '晚上') {
 244							defaultStartTime = '18:00';
 245							defaultEndTime = '21:00';
 246						}
 247						
 248						this.schedule = {
 249							id: data.id,
 250							scheduleDate: data.scheduleDate,
 251							timeSlot: data.timeSlot,
 252							startTime: defaultStartTime,
 253							endTime: defaultEndTime,
 254							fee: this.estimateFeeBySlotType(data.slotType),
 255							availableSlots: data.availableSlots || 0
 256						};
 257						
 258						// 检查号源是否已满
 259						if (this.schedule.availableSlots === 0) {
 260							this.isScheduleFull = true;
 261						}
 262						
 263						// 如果从URL参数没有获取到doctorId，从排班信息中获取
 264						if (!this.doctorId && data.doctorId) {
 265							this.doctorId = data.doctorId;
 266						}
 267					}
 268				} catch (e) {
 269					console.error('加载排班信息失败:', e);
 270					uni.showToast({ 
 271						title: '加载排班信息失败', 
 272						icon: 'none' 
 273					});
 274				}
 275			},
 276			
 277			// 加载医生信息
 278			async loadDoctor() {
 279				try {
 280					if (!this.doctorId) return;
 281					const data = await getDoctorById(this.doctorId);
 282					this.doctorInfo = data || {};
 283				} catch (e) {
 284					console.error('加载医生信息失败:', e);
 285				}
 286			},
 287			
 288			// 加载患者信息
 289			async loadPatientInfo() {
 290				try {
 291					// 从API获取最新的患者信息（包含认证状态）
 292					const data = await getPatientProfile();
 293					console.log('获取到的患者信息:', data); // 调试日志
 294					
 295					this.patientInfo = {
 296						name: data.name || '',
 297						specificRole: data.specificRole || '',
 298						idStatus: data.idStatus || ''
 299					};
 300					
 301					console.log('设置后的patientInfo:', this.patientInfo); // 调试日志
 302					console.log('认证状态:', this.isIdentityVerified); // 调试日志
 303					
 304					// 同步更新store中的用户信息
 305					this.$store.commit('user/SET_USERINFO', {
 306						...this.userInfo,
 307						name: data.name,
 308						specificRole: data.specificRole,
 309						idStatus: data.idStatus
 310					});
 311				} catch (e) {
 312					console.error('加载患者信息失败:', e);
 313					// 如果API失败，尝试从store获取
 314					const userInfo = this.userInfo;
 315					this.patientInfo = {
 316						name: userInfo.name || userInfo.username || '',
 317						specificRole: userInfo.specificRole || '',
 318						idStatus: userInfo.idStatus || ''
 319					};
 320				}
 321			},
 322			
 323			// 估算费用（根据医生职称）
 324			estimateFee() {
 325				const title = this.doctorInfo.title || '';
 326				if (title.includes('主任')) return 50;
 327				if (title.includes('副主任')) return 30;
 328				if (title.includes('主治')) return 20;
 329				return 15;
 330			},
 331			
 332			// 根据号别类型估算费用
 333			estimateFeeBySlotType(slotType) {
 334				if (slotType === 'vip' || slotType === 'VIP') return 100;
 335				if (slotType === 'expert' || slotType === '专家') return 50;
 336				return 15; // normal/普通
 337			},
 338			
 339			// 格式化显示日期
 340			formatDisplayDate(dateStr) {
 341				if (!dateStr) return '';
 342				const date = new Date(dateStr);
 343				const year = date.getFullYear();
 344				const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
 345				const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
 346				const weekDays = ['周日', '周一', '周二', '周三', '周四', '周五', '周六'];
 347				const weekDay = weekDays[date.getDay()];
 348				return `${year}-${month}-${day} ${weekDay}`;
 349			},
 350			
 351			// 显示时间段
 352			displayPeriod(slot) {
 353				const s = String(slot || '').toLowerCase();
 354				if (s.includes('morning') || s.includes('上午')) return '上午';
 355				if (s.includes('afternoon') || s.includes('下午')) return '下午';
 356				if (s.includes('evening') || s.includes('晚上')) return '晚上';
 357				return slot || '-';
 358			},
 359			
 360			// 生成预约时间（后端要求格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss）
 361			getAppointmentTime() {
 362				let dateStr = this.schedule.scheduleDate;
 363				const startTime = this.schedule.startTime || '08:00';
 364				
 365				console.log('原始 scheduleDate:', dateStr);
 366				console.log('原始 startTime:', startTime);
 367				
 368				// 验证日期是否存在
 369				if (!dateStr) {
 370					console.error('scheduleDate为空！schedule对象:', this.schedule);
 371					return null;
 372				}
 373				
 374				// 处理日期格式，确保为 yyyy-MM-dd 格式
 375				if (dateStr.includes('T')) {
 376					// 如果是 ISO 格式 (2025-11-18T00:00:00)，提取日期部分
 377					dateStr = dateStr.split('T')[0];
 378				} else if (dateStr.length > 10) {
 379					// 如果包含时间部分，只取日期
 380					dateStr = dateStr.substring(0, 10);
 381				}
 382				
 383				// 确保时间格式为 HH:mm:ss
 384				let time = startTime;
 385				if (time.length === 5) {
 386					// HH:mm 格式，补充秒
 387					time = `${time}:00`;
 388				} else if (time.length === 8) {
 389					// 已经是 HH:mm:ss 格式
 390					// 不需要处理
 391				} else {
 392					// 其他情况，默认补充
 393					time = `${time}:00`;
 394				}
 395				
 396				const result = `${dateStr} ${time}`;
 397				console.log('最终拼接的预约时间:', result);
 398				console.log('日期部分:', dateStr, '时间部分:', time);
 399				
 400				return result;
 401			},
 402			
 403			// 跳转到身份认证页面
 404			goToVerify() {
 405				uni.showModal({
 406					title: '身份认证提示',
 407					content: '进行身份认证后可享受医保报销优惠，是否前往认证？',
 408					confirmText: '去认证',
 409					cancelText: '稍后再说',
 410					success: (res) => {
 411						if (res.confirm) {
 412							uni.navigateTo({
 413								url: '/pages/personal-info/personal-info'
 414							});
 415						}
 416					}
 417				});
 418			},
 419			
 420			// 提交预约
 421			async submitOrder() {
 422				// 如果号源已满，不允許提交
 423				if (this.isScheduleFull) {
 424					uni.showToast({ 
 425						title: '号源已满，请加入候补队列', 
 426						icon: 'none' 
 427					});
 428					return;
 429				}
 430				
 431				if (!this.scheduleId) {
 432					uni.showToast({ title: '参数缺失：scheduleId', icon: 'none' });
 433					return;
 434				}
 435				
 436				const appointmentTime = this.getAppointmentTime();
 437				
 438				// 验证预约时间是否生成成功
 439				if (!appointmentTime) {
 440					uni.showToast({ 
 441						title: '无法获取排班时间，请重试', 
 442						icon: 'none' 
 443					});
 444					return;
 445				}
 446				
 447				// 验证格式：必须包含日期和时间两部分
 448				if (!appointmentTime.includes(' ') || appointmentTime.split(' ').length !== 2) {
 449					console.error('预约时间格式错误:', appointmentTime);
 450					uni.showToast({ 
 451						title: '时间格式错误，请重试', 
 452						icon: 'none' 
 453					});
 454					return;
 455				}
 456				
 457				const [datePart, timePart] = appointmentTime.split(' ');
 458				if (!datePart || datePart.length !== 10) {
 459					console.error('日期部分格式错误:', datePart);
 460					uni.showToast({ 
 461						title: '日期格式错误，请重试', 
 462						icon: 'none' 
 463					});
 464					return;
 465				}
 466				if (!timePart || timePart.length !== 8) {
 467					console.error('时间部分格式错误:', timePart);
 468					uni.showToast({ 
 469						title: '时间格式错误，请重试', 
 470						icon: 'none' 
 471					});
 472					return;
 473				}
 474				
 475				this.submitting = true;
 476				try {
 477					console.log('=== 提交预约开始 ===')
 478					console.log('scheduleId:', this.scheduleId);
 479					console.log('appointmentTime:', appointmentTime);
 480					console.log('appointmentTime 类型:', typeof appointmentTime);
 481					console.log('appointmentTime 长度:', appointmentTime.length);
 482					
 483					const requestData = {
 484						scheduleId: this.scheduleId,
 485						appointmentTime: appointmentTime
 486					};
 487					console.log('请求数据:', JSON.stringify(requestData));
 488					
 489					await createAppointment(requestData);
 490					
 491					uni.showToast({ 
 492						title: '预约成功', 
 493						icon: 'success',
 494						success: () => {
 495							setTimeout(() => {
 496								uni.switchTab({ url: '/pages/records/records' });
 497							}, 1500);
 498						}
 499					});
 500				} catch (e) {
 501					console.error('=== 预约失败 ===');
 502					console.error('错误对象:', e);
 503					uni.showToast({ 
 504						title: e.msg || '预约失败', 
 505						icon: 'none',
 506						duration: 2500
 507					});
 508				} finally {
 509					this.submitting = false;
 510				}
 511			},
 512			
 513			// 返回上一页
 514			goBack() {
 515				uni.navigateBack();
 516			},
 517			
 518			// 加入候补队列
 519			async joinWaitlist() {
 520				// 检查是否已登录 - 修复登录检查逻辑
 521				const token = this.$store.state.user.token;
 522				console.log('Token:', token);
 523				
 524				if (!token) {
 525					uni.showToast({ title: '请先登录', icon: 'none' });
 526					// 延迟跳转到登录页面
 527					setTimeout(() => {
 528						uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login' });
 529					}, 1000);
 530					return;
 531				}
 532				
 533				try {
 534					await joinWaitlist({ scheduleId: this.scheduleId });
 535					uni.showToast({ 
 536						title: '已加入候补队列', 
 537						icon: 'success',
 538						success: () => {
 539							// 跳转到候补详情页面
 540							uni.navigateTo({
 541								url: `/pages/waitlist/waitlist?scheduleId=${this.scheduleId}&doctorId=${this.doctorId}&scheduleDate=${this.schedule.scheduleDate}&timeSlot=${this.schedule.timeSlot}`
 542							});
 543						}
 544					});
 545				} catch (e) {
 546					uni.showToast({ title: e.msg || '加入失败', icon: 'none' });
 547				}
 548			}
 549		}
 550	};
 551	</script>

 94	-- 8. 创建排班表 (schedule)
 95	CREATE TABLE `schedule` (

 170	 `paid_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '已支付金额',

 172	 `payment_method` VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '支付方式 (ALIPAY, WECHAT, BALANCE等)',

 187	 INDEX `idx_expire_time` (`expire_time`)
 188	) COMMENT='候补预支付订单表';

 214	 `end_date` DATE NULL COMMENT '规则生效结束日期',

 225

 233	 `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
 234	 `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
 235	 
 236	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

 240	 INDEX `idx_rule_doctor` (`doctor_id`),

 242	) COMMENT='排班规则配置表 - 管理员可设置自动化排班策略';

 246	-- ========================================
 247	CREATE TABLE `application_request` (

 256	 `original_date` DATE NULL COMMENT '原出诊日期',
 257	 `original_time_slot` VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '原时间段',
 258	 `new_date` DATE NULL COMMENT '新出诊日期 (改期时使用)',
 259	 `new_time_slot` VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '新时间段 (改期时使用)',
 260	 `slot_adjustment` INT NULL COMMENT '号源调整数量 (正数增加/负数减少)',
 261	 
 262	 -- 信息修改申请相关字段
 263	 `doctor_id` BIGINT NULL COMMENT '要修改信息的医生ID (信息修改申请时使用)',
 264	 `field_name` VARCHAR(100) NULL COMMENT '要修改的字段名 (如: name/title/specialty/bio)',
 265	 `old_value` TEXT NULL COMMENT '原值',
 266	 `new_value` TEXT NULL COMMENT '新值',
 267	 
 268	 -- 申请状态与处理
 269	 `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' COMMENT '申请状态 (PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED)',
 270	 `reason` TEXT NULL COMMENT '申请理由',
 271	 `reject_reason` TEXT NULL COMMENT '拒绝原因',
 272	 `reviewer_id` BIGINT NULL COMMENT '审核人用户ID',
 273	 `reviewed_at` DATETIME NULL COMMENT '审核时间',
 274	 
 275	 -- 审计信息
 276	 `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '申请创建时间',
 277	 `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '最后更新时间',
 278	 
 279	 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 280	 FOREIGN KEY (`applicant_id`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 281	 FOREIGN KEY (`schedule_id`) REFERENCES `schedule`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 282	 FOREIGN KEY (`doctor_id`) REFERENCES `doctor`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 283	 FOREIGN KEY (`reviewer_id`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
 284	 INDEX `idx_request_type` (`request_type`),
 285	 INDEX `idx_request_status` (`status`),
 286	 INDEX `idx_applicant` (`applicant_id`),
 287	 INDEX `idx_doctor` (`doctor_id`)
 288	) COMMENT='统一申请记录表 - 管理调班申请和医生信息修改申请';

 1	// 文件路径: src/main/java/com/example/springboot/service/WaitlistService.java
 2	package com.example.springboot.service;
 3	
 4	import com.example.springboot.dto.WaitlistInfoDTO; // <-- [新增] 导入
 5	import com.example.springboot.entity.Schedule;
 6	import com.example.springboot.entity.Doctor;
 7	import com.example.springboot.exception.CustomerException;
 8	import com.example.springboot.mapper.ScheduleMapper;
 9	import com.example.springboot.mapper.DoctorMapper;
 10	import jakarta.annotation.Resource;
 11	import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate; // <-- [新增] 导入
 12	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 13	
 14	import java.util.Date;
 15	import java.util.List;
 16	import java.util.Set;
 17	import java.util.Objects;
 18	import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 19	
 20	@Service
 21	public class WaitlistService {
 22	
 23	 @Resource
 24	 private ScheduleMapper scheduleMapper; // <-- [保留] 仍然需要
 25	
 26	 @Resource
 27	 private DoctorMapper doctorMapper;
 28	
 29	 // [修改] 注入 RedisTemplate (使用 Object, 配合 RedisConfig)
 30	 @Resource
 31	 private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
 32	
 33	 // [修改] 移除 WaitlistMapper
 34	
 35	 // 定义 Redis Key 的前缀
 36	 // 候补队列 (ZSET): "waitlist:schedule:{scheduleId}" -> ZSET [ patientId, joinTime ]
 37	 private static final String WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX = "waitlist:schedule:";
 38	 // 患者的候补列表 (SET): "waitlist:patient:{patientId}" -> SET [ "scheduleId1", "scheduleId2" ]
 39	 private static final String PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX = "waitlist:patient:";
 40	
 41	
 42	 /** [重构] 加入候补队列 (使用 Redis ZSET) */
 43	 public void addToQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 44	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 45	 if (schedule == null) {
 46	 throw new CustomerException("排班不存在");
 47	 }
 48	 if (schedule.getAvailableSlots() != null && schedule.getAvailableSlots() > 0) {
 49	 throw new CustomerException("当前仍有号源，可直接预约");
 50	 }
 51	
 52	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 53	
 54	 // 检查是否已在队列中 (score不为null说明已存在)
 55	 Double score = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().score(key, patientId);
 56	 if (score != null) {
 57	 throw new CustomerException("已在候补队列中，请勿重复提交");
 58	 }
 59	
 60	 // 1. 加入 ZSET，分数为当前时间戳
 61	 long joinTime = new Date().getTime();
 62	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().add(key, patientId, (double) joinTime);
 63	
 64	 // 2. 额外维护一个反向索引 (用于 "我的候补" 查询)
 65	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 66	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().add(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 67	 }
 68	
 69	 /** [重构] 弹出队首 (从 ZSET 中弹出分数最低的) */
 70	 public Long popNext(Long scheduleId) {
 71	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 72	
 73	 // 弹出分数最低（即最早加入）的 1 个元素
 74	 // 注意: popMin 返回一个包含 TypedTuple 的 Set，我们需要从中提取值
 75	 Set<Object> result = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().popMin(key, 1)
 76	 .stream()
 77	 .map(tuple -> ((org.springframework.data.redis.core.ZSetOperations.TypedTuple<Object>) tuple).getValue())
 78	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 79	
 80	 if (result.isEmpty()) {
 81	 return null; // 队列为空
 82	 }
 83	
 84	 // (注意: 序列化配置会导致这里可能是Integer或String)
 85	 // 确保使用 Long 类型
 86	 Long patientId = ((Number) result.iterator().next()).longValue();
 87	
 88	 // 3. (清理) 从该患者的反向索引中移除这个排班
 89	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 90	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 91	
 92	 return patientId;
 93	 }
 94	
 95	 /** [重构] 根据患者ID查询候补列表 */
 96	 public List<WaitlistInfoDTO> listByPatient(Long patientId) {
 97	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 98	
 99	 // 1. 获取该患者候补的所有 scheduleId
 100	 Set<Object> scheduleIdObjects = redisTemplate.opsForSet().members(patientKey);
 101	 if (scheduleIdObjects == null || scheduleIdObjects.isEmpty()) {
 102	 return List.of(); // 返回空列表
 103	 }
 104	
 105	 // 2. 遍历，查询每个队列中该 patientId 的排名，并补充展示所需信息
 106	 return scheduleIdObjects.stream()
 107	 .map(obj -> {
 108	 if (!(obj instanceof Number) && !(obj instanceof String)) {
 109	 return null;
 110	 }
 111	 try {
 112	 Long scheduleId = Long.valueOf(String.valueOf(obj));
 113	 String queueKey = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 114	
 115	 Long rank = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().rank(queueKey, patientId);
 116	 Long queueSize = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().size(queueKey);
 117	 if (rank == null) {
 118	 return null;
 119	 }
 120	
 121	 WaitlistInfoDTO dto = new WaitlistInfoDTO(scheduleId, rank, queueSize);
 122	
 123	 // 额外补充：医生与排班信息
 124	 Schedule s = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 125	 if (s != null) {
 126	 dto.setScheduleDate(s.getScheduleDate());
 127	 dto.setTimeSlot(s.getTimeSlot());
 128	 dto.setTimeSlotName(timeSlotToCn(s.getTimeSlot()));
 129	 dto.setDoctorId(s.getDoctorId());
 130	 try {
 131	 Doctor d = doctorMapper.selectById(s.getDoctorId());
 132	 if (d != null) dto.setDoctorName(d.getName());
 133	 } catch (Exception ignored) {}
 134	 }
 135	 return dto;
 136	 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
 137	 System.err.println("Invalid scheduleId format in Redis set: " + obj);
 138	 return null;
 139	 }
 140	 })
 141	 .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull)
 142	 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 143	 }
 144	
 145	 /** [新增] 从候补队列中移除 */
 146	 public void removeFromQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 147	 String queueKey = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 148	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 149	 // 1. 从 ZSET 中移除患者
 150	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().remove(queueKey, patientId);
 151	 // 2. 从患者的反向索引 SET 中移除 scheduleId
 152	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 153	 }
 154	
 155	 private String timeSlotToCn(String timeSlot) {
 156	 if (timeSlot == null) return null;
 157	 switch (timeSlot.toLowerCase()) {
 158	 case "morning": return "上午";
 159	 case "afternoon": return "下午";
 160	 case "evening": return "晚上";
 161	 default: return timeSlot;
 162	 }
 163	 }

 29	 private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PrepaymentOrderService.class);
 30	
 31	 @Resource
 32	 private PrepaymentOrderMapper prepaymentOrderMapper;
 33	
 34	 @Resource
 35	 private WaitlistMapper waitlistMapper;
 36	
 37	 @Resource
 38	 private PatientMapper patientMapper;
 39	
 40	 @Resource
 41	 private ScheduleMapper scheduleMapper;
 42	
 43	 @Resource
 44	 private SystemConfigService systemConfigService;

 46	 /**
 47	 * 创建候补预支付订单
 48	 * @param patientId 患者ID
 49	 * @param scheduleId 排班ID
 50	 * @param waitlistId 候补记录ID
 51	 * @return 创建的预支付订单
 52	 */
 53	 @Transactional
 54	 public PrepaymentOrder createWaitlistPrepayment(Long patientId, Long scheduleId, Long waitlistId) {
 55	 // 1. 检查候补记录是否存在
 56	 Waitlist waitlist = waitlistMapper.selectById(waitlistId);
 57	 if (waitlist == null) {
 58	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录不存在");
 59	 }
 60	 
 61	 // 2. 检查患者ID是否匹配
 62	 if (!waitlist.getPatientId().equals(patientId)) {
 63	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录与患者不匹配");
 64	 }
 65	 
 66	 // 3. 检查排班ID是否匹配
 67	 if (!waitlist.getScheduleId().equals(scheduleId)) {
 68	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录与排班不匹配");
 69	 }
 70	 
 71	 // 4. 检查是否已经存在预支付订单
 72	 PrepaymentOrder existingOrder = prepaymentOrderMapper.selectByWaitlistId(waitlistId);
 73	 if (existingOrder != null) {
 74	 // 如果订单已过期，则可以重新创建
 75	 if ("EXPIRED".equals(existingOrder.getStatus())) {
 76	 prepaymentOrderMapper.delete(existingOrder.getId());
 77	 } else {
 78	 return existingOrder; // 返回已存在的订单
 79	 }
 80	 }
 81	 
 82	 // 5. 获取排班信息，计算费用
 83	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 84	 if (schedule == null) {
 85	 throw new CustomerException("排班信息不存在");
 86	 }
 87	 
 88	 // 6. 计算原始费用和实际费用
 89	 BigDecimal originalFee = calculateOriginalFee(schedule.getSlotType());
 90	 BigDecimal actualFee = calculateActualFee(patientId, originalFee);
 91	 
 92	 // 7. 生成订单号
 93	 String orderNo = generateOrderNo();
 94	 
 95	 // 8. 设置过期时间（默认30分钟）
 96	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 97	 calendar.add(Calendar.MINUTE, 30);
 98	 Date expireTime = calendar.getTime();
 99	 
 100	 // 9. 创建预支付订单
 101	 PrepaymentOrder order = new PrepaymentOrder();
 102	 order.setOrderNo(orderNo);
 103	 order.setPatientId(patientId);
 104	 order.setScheduleId(scheduleId);
 105	 order.setWaitlistId(waitlistId);
 106	 order.setOrderType("WAITLIST");
 107	 order.setOriginalFee(originalFee);
 108	 order.setActualFee(actualFee);
 109	 order.setPaidAmount(BigDecimal.ZERO);
 110	 order.setStatus("PENDING");
 111	 order.setExpireTime(expireTime);
 112	 order.setCreatedAt(new Date());
 113	 order.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
 114	 
 115	 // 10. 保存订单
 116	 prepaymentOrderMapper.insert(order);
 117	 
 118	 return order;
 119	 }
 120	 
 121	 /**
 122	 * 支付预支付订单
 123	 * @param orderNo 订单号
 124	 * @param paymentMethod 支付方式
 125	 * @param paidAmount 支付金额
 126	 * @return 更新后的订单
 127	 */
 128	 @Transactional
 129	 public PrepaymentOrder payOrder(String orderNo, String paymentMethod, BigDecimal paidAmount) {
 130	 // 1. 查询订单
 131	 PrepaymentOrder order = prepaymentOrderMapper.selectByOrderNo(orderNo);
 132	 if (order == null) {
 133	 throw new CustomerException("订单不存在");
 134	 }
 135	 
 136	 // 2. 检查订单状态
 137	 if (!"PENDING".equals(order.getStatus())) {
 138	 throw new CustomerException("订单状态不正确，无法支付");
 139	 }
 140	 
 141	 // 3. 检查订单是否过期
 142	 if (order.getExpireTime().before(new Date())) {
 143	 order.setStatus("EXPIRED");
 144	 prepaymentOrderMapper.updateStatus(order.getId(), "EXPIRED");
 145	 throw new CustomerException("订单已过期，请重新创建");
 146	 }
 147	 
 148	 // 4. 检查支付金额
 149	 if (paidAmount.compareTo(order.getActualFee()) < 0) {
 150	 throw new CustomerException("支付金额不足");
 151	 }
 152	 
 153	 // 5. 更新订单状态和支付信息
 154	 prepaymentOrderMapper.updatePaymentInfo(
 155	 order.getId(),
 156	 "PAID",
 157	 paymentMethod,
 158	 new Date(),
 159	 paidAmount
 160	 );
 161	 
 162	 // 6. 重新查询并返回更新后的订单
 163	 return prepaymentOrderMapper.selectById(order.getId());
 164	 }

 166	 /**
 167	 * 退款
 168	 * @param orderNo 订单号
 169	 * @param reason 退款原因
 170	 * @return 更新后的订单
 171	 */
 172	 @Transactional
 173	 public PrepaymentOrder refundOrder(String orderNo, String reason) {
 174	 // 1. 查询订单
 175	 PrepaymentOrder order = prepaymentOrderMapper.selectByOrderNo(orderNo);
 176	 if (order == null) {
 177	 throw new CustomerException("订单不存在");
 178	 }
 179	 
 180	 // 2. 检查订单状态
 181	 if (!"PAID".equals(order.getStatus())) {
 182	 throw new CustomerException("订单状态不正确，无法退款");
 183	 }
 184	 
 185	 // 3. 更新订单状态和退款信息
 186	 prepaymentOrderMapper.updateRefundInfo(
 187	 order.getId(),
 188	 "REFUNDED",
 189	 new Date(),
 190	 reason
 191	 );
 192	 
 193	 // 4. 重新查询并返回更新后的订单
 194	 return prepaymentOrderMapper.selectById(order.getId());
 195	 }

 199	 * @param waitlistId 候补记录ID

 203	 public PrepaymentOrder consumeOrder(Long waitlistId) {
 204	 // 1. 查询订单
 205	 PrepaymentOrder order = prepaymentOrderMapper.selectByWaitlistId(waitlistId);
 206	 if (order == null) {
 207	 throw new CustomerException("预支付订单不存在");

 212	 throw new CustomerException("订单状态不正确，无法消费");
 213	 }
 214	 
 215	 // 3. 更新订单状态
 216	 prepaymentOrderMapper.updateStatus(order.getId(), "CONSUMED");
 217	 
 218	 // 4. 重新查询并返回更新后的订单
 219	 return prepaymentOrderMapper.selectById(order.getId());
 220	 }

 225	 @Transactional
 226	 public void processExpiredOrders() {
 227	 List<PrepaymentOrder> expiredOrders = prepaymentOrderMapper.selectExpiredOrders();
 228	 for (PrepaymentOrder order : expiredOrders) {

 238	 public void processRefundOrders() {
 239	 List<PrepaymentOrder> refundOrders = prepaymentOrderMapper.selectOrdersForRefund();
 240	 for (PrepaymentOrder order : refundOrders) {
 241	 try {
 242	 refundOrder(order.getOrderNo(), "候补失败或取消，系统自动退款");
 243	 logger.info("订单已退款: {}", order.getOrderNo());
 244	 } catch (Exception e) {
 245	 logger.error("订单退款失败: {}, 原因: {}", order.getOrderNo(), e.getMessage());
 246	 }
 247	 }
 248	 }

 250	 /**
 251	 * 根据排班类型计算原始费用
 252	 */
 253	 private BigDecimal calculateOriginalFee(String slotType) {
 254	 String normalized = slotType == null ? "NORMAL" : slotType.trim().toUpperCase();
 255	 String key;
 256	 switch (normalized) {
 257	 case "EXPERT":
 258	 key = "FEE_EXPERT";
 259	 break;
 260	 case "VIP":
 261	 key = "FEE_VIP";
 262	 break;
 263	 default:
 264	 key = "FEE_NORMAL";
 265	 }
 266	 return systemConfigService.getDecimalOrDefault(key, new BigDecimal("0.00"));
 267	 }

 269	 /**
 270	 * 根据患者身份计算实际支付费用
 271	 */
 272	 private BigDecimal calculateActualFee(Long patientId, BigDecimal originalFee) {
 273	 try {
 274	 Patient patient = patientMapper.selectById(patientId);
 275	 if (patient == null) {
 276	 return originalFee;
 277	 }
 278	 
 279	 String specificRole = patient.getSpecificRole();
 280	 if (specificRole == null || !"verified".equals(patient.getIdStatus())) {
 281	 // 未认证或无身份信息，不享受报销
 282	 return originalFee;
 283	 }
 284	 
 285	 // 根据身份类型计算报销后的实际费用
 286	 if ("student".equals(specificRole)) {
 287	 // 学生报销95%，实付5%
 288	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.05"));
 289	 } else if ("teacher".equals(specificRole)) {
 290	 // 教师报销90%，实付10%
 291	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.10"));
 292	 }
 293	 
 294	 return originalFee;
 295	 } catch (Exception e) {
 296	 logger.warn("计算实际费用失败: {}", e.getMessage());
 297	 return originalFee;
 298	 }
 299	 }

 332	 private String generateOrderNo() {
 333	 // 生成格式: WL + 时间戳 + 4位随机数
 334	 String timestamp = String.valueOf(System.currentTimeMillis());
 335	 String random = String.format("%04d", (int)(Math.random() * 10000));
 336	 return "WL" + timestamp + random;
 337	 }

 312	 /**
 313	 * 生成日期列表（批量创建排班时使用）
 314	 */
 315	 private List<Date> generateDateList(Date startDate, Date endDate, Boolean skipWeekends, List<Date> excludeDates) {
 316	 List<Date> dateList = new ArrayList<>();
 317	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 318	 calendar.setTime(startDate);
 319	 calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
 320	 calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
 321	 calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
 322	 calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
 323	
 324	 while (!calendar.getTime().after(endDate)) {
 325	 Date currentDate = calendar.getTime();
 326	
 327	 // 检查是否需要跳过周末
 328	 if (skipWeekends != null && skipWeekends) {
 329	 int dayOfWeek = calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 330	 if (dayOfWeek == Calendar.SATURDAY || dayOfWeek == Calendar.SUNDAY) {
 331	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 332	 continue;
 333	 }
 334	 }
 335	
 336	 // 检查是否在排除日期中
 337	 boolean isExcluded = false;
 338	 if (excludeDates != null) {
 339	 for (Date excludeDate : excludeDates) {
 340	 Calendar excludeCal = Calendar.getInstance();
 341	 excludeCal.setTime(excludeDate);
 342	 if (calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.YEAR) &&
 343	 calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR)) {
 344	 isExcluded = true;
 345	 break;
 346	 }
 347	 }
 348	 }
 349	
 350	 if (!isExcluded) {
 351	 dateList.add(currentDate);
 352	 }
 353	
 354	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 355	 }
 356	
 357	 return dateList;
 358	 }

 213	 // 将患者重新加入候补队列
 214	 waitlistService.addToQueue(nextPatientId, scheduleId);
 215	 return false;
 216	 }
 217	
 218	 // 4. 为队首患者创建预约
 219	 Appointment newAppointment = new Appointment();
 220	 newAppointment.setPatientId(nextPatientId);
 221	 newAppointment.setScheduleId(scheduleId);
 222	 newAppointment.setStatus("scheduled"); // 直接设为已预约状态
 223	 newAppointment.setSourceType("WAITLIST");
 224	
 225	 // [修复] 必须设置预约时间
 226	 Date now = new java.util.Date();
 227	 newAppointment.setCreatedAt(now);
 228	 newAppointment.setAppointmentTime(now);
 229	
 230	 // 5. 从 schedule 表查询医生ID
 231	 var schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 232	 if (schedule != null) {
 233	 newAppointment.setDoctorId(schedule.getDoctorId());
 234	 }
 235	
 236	 // 6. 扣减号源（如果还有余量）
 237	 int decreased = scheduleMapper.decreaseAvailableSlots(scheduleId);
 238	 if (decreased <= 0) {
 239	 logger.warn("候补创建失败：无可用号源 scheduleId={}", scheduleId);
 240	 // 将患者重新加入候补队列
 241	 waitlistService.addToQueue(nextPatientId, scheduleId);
 242	 return false;
 243	 }
 244	
 245	 // 7. 使用预支付订单中的费用信息
 246	 newAppointment.setFee(prepaymentOrder.getOriginalFee());
 247	 newAppointment.setActualFee(prepaymentOrder.getActualFee());
 248	
 249	 // 8. 入库预约记录
 250	 appointmentMapper.insert(newAppointment);
 251	
 252	 // 9. 消费预支付订单
 253	 try {
 254	 prepaymentOrderService.consumeOrder(prepaymentOrder.getWaitlistId());
 255	 } catch (Exception e) {
 256	 logger.error("消费预支付订单失败: {}", e.getMessage());
 257	 // 这里可以考虑是否需要回滚预约创建，但为了简化流程，我们继续处理
 258	 }
 259	
 260	 // 10. 更新日志
 261	 logger.info("候补队列自动创建预约成功: 患者ID={}, 排班ID={}, 订单号={}",
 262	 nextPatientId, scheduleId, prepaymentOrder.getOrderNo());
 263	 return true;
 264	 }
 265	 } catch (Exception e) {
 266	 // 记录日志但不影响主流程
 267	 logger.error("处理候补队列失败: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
 268	 }
 269	 return false;
 270	 }
 271	
 272	 /**
 273	 * 取消预约（更新状态为cancelled）
 274	 * 权限检查：管理员可以取消任何预约，患者只能取消自己的预约
 275	 */
 276	 public int cancelById(Long id) {
 277	 // 查询预约信息
 278	 Appointment appointment = appointmentMapper.selectById(id);
 279	 if (appointment == null) {
 280	 throw new CustomerException("预约不存在");
 281	 }
 282	
 283	 // 如果当前用户不是管理员，则检查是否为本人操作
 284	 if (!SecurityUtils.isAdmin()) {
 285	 Long currentUserId = SecurityUtils.getCurrentUserId();
 286	 if (currentUserId == null) {
 287	 throw new CustomerException("401", "未登录");
 288	 }
 289	
 290	 // 通过 patientId 查询患者信息，获取对应的 userId
 291	 Patient patient = patientMapper.selectById(appointment.getPatientId());
 292	 if (patient == null) {
 293	 throw new CustomerException("患者信息不存在");
 294	 }
 295	
 296	 // 检查是否为本人（比较 userId）
 297	 if (!currentUserId.equals(patient.getUserId())) {
 298	 logger.warn("用户 {} 尝试取消预约 {}，但该预约属于用户 {}",
 299	 currentUserId, id, patient.getUserId());
 300	 throw new CustomerException("403", "无权限取消其他患者的预约");
 301	 }
 302	 }
 303	
 304	 // 退号时限：就诊前2小时内不可退号（可通过配置覆盖）
 305	 int cancelLimitMinutes = systemConfigService.getIntOrDefault("CANCEL_LIMIT_MINUTES", 120);
 306	 Date now = new Date();
 307	
 308	 // [修复] 确保 appointmentTime 不为 null
 309	 if (appointment.getAppointmentTime() == null) {
 310	 logger.warn("预约 {} 的 appointmentTime 为 null，跳过退号时限检查", id);
 311	 } else {
 312	 long diffMillis = appointment.getAppointmentTime().getTime() - now.getTime();
 313	 long remainMinutes = diffMillis / (60 * 1000);
 314	 if (remainMinutes < cancelLimitMinutes) {
 315	 throw new CustomerException("距离就诊不足" + cancelLimitMinutes + "分钟，不可退号");
 316	 }
 317	 }
 318	
 319	 int result = appointmentMapper.updateStatus(id, "cancelled");
 320	
 321	 // 如果取消成功，尝试从候补队列中弹出下一个患者并创建预约；若无候补则归还号源
 322	 if (result > 0) {
 323	 boolean filled = processNextInWaitlist(appointment.getScheduleId());
 324	 if (!filled) {
 325	 try {
 326	 scheduleMapper.increaseAvailableSlots(appointment.getScheduleId());
 327	 } catch (Exception e) {
 328	 logger.warn("归还号源失败: {}", e.getMessage());
 329	 }
 330	 }
 331	 }
 332	
 333	 return result;
 334	 }

 369	 /**
 370	 * 根据患者身份计算实际支付费用
 371	 */
 372	 private BigDecimal calculateActualFee(Long patientId, BigDecimal originalFee) {
 373	 try {
 374	 Patient patient = patientMapper.selectById(patientId);
 375	 if (patient == null) {
 376	 return originalFee;
 377	 }
 378	 
 379	 String specificRole = patient.getSpecificRole();
 380	 if (specificRole == null || !"verified".equals(patient.getIdStatus())) {
 381	 // 未认证或无身份信息，不享受报销
 382	 return originalFee;
 383	 }
 384	 
 385	 // 根据身份类型计算报销后的实际费用
 386	 if ("student".equals(specificRole)) {
 387	 // 学生报锅95%，实付5%
 388	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.05"));
 389	 } else if ("teacher".equals(specificRole)) {
 390	 // 教师报锅90%，实付10%
 391	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.10"));
 392	 }
 393	 
 394	 return originalFee;
 395	 } catch (Exception e) {
 396	 logger.warn("计算实际费用失败: {}", e.getMessage());
 397	 return originalFee;
 398	 }
 399	 }

 405	 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.MINUTE, 0);

 407	 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);

 521			formatDate(dateStr) {
 522				if (!dateStr) return '';
 523				const date = new Date(dateStr);
 524				const year = date.getFullYear();
 525				const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
 526				const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
 527				return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
 528			}

 407					content: '进行身份认证后可享受医保报销优惠，是否前往认证？',
 408					confirmText: '去认证',
 409					cancelText: '稍后再说',
 410					success: (res) => {
 411						if (res.confirm) {

 414							});
 415						}

 417				});

 419			
 420			// 提交预约
 421			async submitOrder() {
 422				// 如果号源已满，不允許提交
 423				if (this.isScheduleFull) {
 424					uni.showToast({ 
 425						title: '号源已满，请加入候补队列', 
 426						icon: 'none' 
 427					});
 428					return;
 429				}
 430				
 431				if (!this.scheduleId) {
 432					uni.showToast({ title: '参数缺失：scheduleId', icon: 'none' });
 433					return;
 434				}
 435				
 436				const appointmentTime = this.getAppointmentTime();
 437				
 438				// 验证预约时间是否生成成功
 439				if (!appointmentTime) {
 440					uni.showToast({ 
 441						title: '无法获取排班时间，请重试', 
 442						icon: 'none' 
 443					});
 444					return;
 445				}
 446				
 447				// 验证格式：必须包含日期和时间两部分
 448				if (!appointmentTime.includes(' ') || appointmentTime.split(' ').length !== 2) {
 449					console.error('预约时间格式错误:', appointmentTime);
 450					uni.showToast({ 
 451						title: '时间格式错误，请重试', 
 452						icon: 'none' 
 453					});
 454					return;
 455				}
 456				
 457				const [datePart, timePart] = appointmentTime.split(' ');
 458				if (!datePart || datePart.length !== 10) {
 459					console.error('日期部分格式错误:', datePart);
 460					uni.showToast({ 
 461						title: '日期格式错误，请重试', 
 462						icon: 'none' 
 463					});
 464					return;
 465				}
 466				if (!timePart || timePart.length !== 8) {
 467					console.error('时间部分格式错误:', timePart);
 468					uni.showToast({ 
 469						title: '时间格式错误，请重试', 
 470						icon: 'none' 
 471					});
 472					return;
 473				}
 474				
 475				this.submitting = true;
 476				try {
 477					console.log('=== 提交预约开始 ===')
 478					console.log('scheduleId:', this.scheduleId);
 479					console.log('appointmentTime:', appointmentTime);
 480					console.log('appointmentTime 类型:', typeof appointmentTime);
 481					console.log('appointmentTime 长度:', appointmentTime.length);
 482					
 483					const requestData = {
 484						scheduleId: this.scheduleId,
 485						appointmentTime: appointmentTime
 486					};
 487					console.log('请求数据:', JSON.stringify(requestData));
 488					
 489					await createAppointment(requestData);
 490					
 491					uni.showToast({ 
 492						title: '预约成功', 
 493						icon: 'success',
 494						success: () => {
 495							setTimeout(() => {
 496								uni.switchTab({ url: '/pages/records/records' });
 497							}, 1500);
 498						}
 499					});
 500				} catch (e) {
 501					console.error('=== 预约失败 ===');
 502					console.error('错误对象:', e);
 503					uni.showToast({ 
 504						title: e.msg || '预约失败', 
 505						icon: 'none',
 506						duration: 2500
 507					});
 508				} finally {
 509					this.submitting = false;
 510				}
 511			},
 512			
 513			// 返回上一页
 514			goBack() {
 515				uni.navigateBack();
 516			},

 518			// 加入候补队列
 519			async joinWaitlist() {
 520				// 检查是否已登录 - 修复登录检查逻辑
 521				const token = this.$store.state.user.token;
 522				console.log('Token:', token);
 523				
 524				if (!token) {
 525					uni.showToast({ title: '请先登录', icon: 'none' });
 526					// 延迟跳转到登录页面
 527					setTimeout(() => {
 528						uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login' });
 529					}, 1000);
 530					return;
 531				}
 532				
 533				try {
 534					await joinWaitlist({ scheduleId: this.scheduleId });
 535					uni.showToast({ 
 536						title: '已加入候补队列', 
 537						icon: 'success',
 538						success: () => {
 539							// 跳转到候补详情页面
 540							uni.navigateTo({
 541								url: `/pages/waitlist/waitlist?scheduleId=${this.scheduleId}&doctorId=${this.doctorId}&scheduleDate=${this.schedule.scheduleDate}&timeSlot=${this.schedule.timeSlot}`
 542							});
 543						}
 544					});
 545				} catch (e) {
 546					uni.showToast({ title: e.msg || '加入失败', icon: 'none' });
 547				}
 548			}
 549		}
 550	};

 2	package com.example.springboot.service;

 4	import com.example.springboot.dto.WaitlistInfoDTO; // <-- [新增] 导入

 20	@Service
 21	public class WaitlistService {
 22	
 23	 @Resource
 24	 private ScheduleMapper scheduleMapper; // <-- [保留] 仍然需要
 25	
 26	 @Resource
 27	 private DoctorMapper doctorMapper;
 28	
 29	 // [修改] 注入 RedisTemplate (使用 Object, 配合 RedisConfig)
 30	 @Resource
 31	 private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
 32	
 33	 // [修改] 移除 WaitlistMapper
 34	
 35	 // 定义 Redis Key 的前缀
 36	 // 候补队列 (ZSET): "waitlist:schedule:{scheduleId}" -> ZSET [ patientId, joinTime ]
 37	 private static final String WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX = "waitlist:schedule:";
 38	 // 患者的候补列表 (SET): "waitlist:patient:{patientId}" -> SET [ "scheduleId1", "scheduleId2" ]
 39	 private static final String PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX = "waitlist:patient:";
 40	
 41	
 42	 /** [重构] 加入候补队列 (使用 Redis ZSET) */
 43	 public void addToQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 44	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 45	 if (schedule == null) {
 46	 throw new CustomerException("排班不存在");
 47	 }
 48	 if (schedule.getAvailableSlots() != null && schedule.getAvailableSlots() > 0) {
 49	 throw new CustomerException("当前仍有号源，可直接预约");
 50	 }
 51	
 52	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 53	
 54	 // 检查是否已在队列中 (score不为null说明已存在)
 55	 Double score = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().score(key, patientId);
 56	 if (score != null) {
 57	 throw new CustomerException("已在候补队列中，请勿重复提交");
 58	 }
 59	
 60	 // 1. 加入 ZSET，分数为当前时间戳
 61	 long joinTime = new Date().getTime();
 62	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().add(key, patientId, (double) joinTime);
 63	
 64	 // 2. 额外维护一个反向索引 (用于 "我的候补" 查询)
 65	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 66	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().add(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 67	 }
 68	
 69	 /** [重构] 弹出队首 (从 ZSET 中弹出分数最低的) */
 70	 public Long popNext(Long scheduleId) {
 71	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 72	
 73	 // 弹出分数最低（即最早加入）的 1 个元素
 74	 // 注意: popMin 返回一个包含 TypedTuple 的 Set，我们需要从中提取值
 75	 Set<Object> result = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().popMin(key, 1)
 76	 .stream()
 77	 .map(tuple -> ((org.springframework.data.redis.core.ZSetOperations.TypedTuple<Object>) tuple).getValue())
 78	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 79	
 80	 if (result.isEmpty()) {
 81	 return null; // 队列为空
 82	 }
 83	
 84	 // (注意: 序列化配置会导致这里可能是Integer或String)
 85	 // 确保使用 Long 类型
 86	 Long patientId = ((Number) result.iterator().next()).longValue();
 87	
 88	 // 3. (清理) 从该患者的反向索引中移除这个排班
 89	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 90	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 91	
 92	 return patientId;
 93	 }

 95	 /** [重构] 根据患者ID查询候补列表 */
 96	 public List<WaitlistInfoDTO> listByPatient(Long patientId) {
 97	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 98	
 99	 // 1. 获取该患者候补的所有 scheduleId
 100	 Set<Object> scheduleIdObjects = redisTemplate.opsForSet().members(patientKey);
 101	 if (scheduleIdObjects == null || scheduleIdObjects.isEmpty()) {
 102	 return List.of(); // 返回空列表
 103	 }
 104	
 105	 // 2. 遍历，查询每个队列中该 patientId 的排名，并补充展示所需信息
 106	 return scheduleIdObjects.stream()
 107	 .map(obj -> {
 108	 if (!(obj instanceof Number) && !(obj instanceof String)) {
 109	 return null;
 110	 }
 111	 try {
 112	 Long scheduleId = Long.valueOf(String.valueOf(obj));
 113	 String queueKey = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 114	
 115	 Long rank = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().rank(queueKey, patientId);
 116	 Long queueSize = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().size(queueKey);
 117	 if (rank == null) {
 118	 return null;
 119	 }
 120	
 121	 WaitlistInfoDTO dto = new WaitlistInfoDTO(scheduleId, rank, queueSize);
 122	
 123	 // 额外补充：医生与排班信息
 124	 Schedule s = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 125	 if (s != null) {
 126	 dto.setScheduleDate(s.getScheduleDate());
 127	 dto.setTimeSlot(s.getTimeSlot());
 128	 dto.setTimeSlotName(timeSlotToCn(s.getTimeSlot()));
 129	 dto.setDoctorId(s.getDoctorId());
 130	 try {
 131	 Doctor d = doctorMapper.selectById(s.getDoctorId());
 132	 if (d != null) dto.setDoctorName(d.getName());
 133	 } catch (Exception ignored) {}
 134	 }
 135	 return dto;
 136	 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
 137	 System.err.println("Invalid scheduleId format in Redis set: " + obj);
 138	 return null;
 139	 }
 140	 })
 141	 .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull)
 142	 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 143	 }

 145	 /** [新增] 从候补队列中移除 */
 146	 public void removeFromQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 147	 String queueKey = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 148	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 149	 // 1. 从 ZSET 中移除患者
 150	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().remove(queueKey, patientId);
 151	 // 2. 从患者的反向索引 SET 中移除 scheduleId
 152	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 153	 }
 154	
 155	 private String timeSlotToCn(String timeSlot) {
 156	 if (timeSlot == null) return null;
 157	 switch (timeSlot.toLowerCase()) {
 158	 case "morning": return "上午";
 159	 case "afternoon": return "下午";
 160	 case "evening": return "晚上";
 161	 default: return timeSlot;
 162	 }
 163	 }

 53	 @Transactional
 54	 public PrepaymentOrder createWaitlistPrepayment(Long patientId, Long scheduleId, Long waitlistId) {
 55	 // 1. 检查候补记录是否存在
 56	 Waitlist waitlist = waitlistMapper.selectById(waitlistId);
 57	 if (waitlist == null) {
 58	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录不存在");
 59	 }
 60	 
 61	 // 2. 检查患者ID是否匹配
 62	 if (!waitlist.getPatientId().equals(patientId)) {
 63	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录与患者不匹配");
 64	 }
 65

 69	 }

 73	 if (existingOrder != null) {

 75	 if ("EXPIRED".equals(existingOrder.getStatus())) {

 87

 159	 paidAmount

 273	 try {
 274	 Patient patient = patientMapper.selectById(patientId);
 275	 if (patient == null) {
 276	 return originalFee;

 278	 
 279	 String specificRole = patient.getSpecificRole();
 280	 if (specificRole == null || !"verified".equals(patient.getIdStatus())) {
 281	 // 未认证或无身份信息，不享受报销
 282	 return originalFee;
 283	 }
 284	 
 285	 // 根据身份类型计算报销后的实际费用
 286	 if ("student".equals(specificRole)) {
 287	 // 学生报销95%，实付5%
 288	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.05"));
 289	 } else if ("teacher".equals(specificRole)) {
 290	 // 教师报销90%，实付10%
 291	 return originalFee.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.10"));
 292	 }
 293	 
 294	 return originalFee;
 295	 } catch (Exception e) {

 297	 return originalFee;

 60	 if (schedule == null) {

 62	 }
