 65	 Date now = new Date();
 66	 if (appointment.getAppointmentTime() == null || !appointment.getAppointmentTime().after(now)) {
 67	 throw new CustomerException("预约时间必须为未来时间");
 68	 }
 69	 Date dayStart = atStartOfDay(schedule.getScheduleDate());
 70	 Date dayEnd = atStartOfNextDay(schedule.getScheduleDate());
 71	 if (appointment.getAppointmentTime().before(dayStart) || !appointment.getAppointmentTime().before(dayEnd)) {
 72	 throw new CustomerException("预约时间与排班日期不一致");
 73	 }
 74	
 75	 // 每个患者每天最多预约N次（默认3）
 76	 Long patientId = appointment.getPatientId();
 77	 int dailyLimit = systemConfigService.getIntOrDefault("APPOINTMENT_DAILY_LIMIT", 3);
 78	 int todayCount = appointmentMapper.countByPatientAndDate(patientId, dayStart, dayEnd);
 79	 if (todayCount >= dailyLimit) {
 80	 throw new CustomerException("当天预约次数已达上限");
 81	 }
 82	
 83	 // 同一排班禁止重复预约
 84	 int exists = appointmentMapper.existsByPatientAndSchedule(patientId, appointment.getScheduleId());
 85	 if (exists > 0) {
 86	 throw new CustomerException("请勿重复预约该排班");
 87	 }
 88	
 89	 // ========== 扣减号源（原子性） ==========
 90	 int decreased = scheduleMapper.decreaseAvailableSlots(schedule.getId());
 91	 if (decreased <= 0) {
 92	 throw new CustomerException("号源不足");
 93	 }
 94	
 95	 // ========== 费用计算 ==========
 96	 try {
 97	 if (appointment.getFee() == null || appointment.getFee().compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0) {
 98	 String slotType = schedule.getSlotType();
 99	 String normalized = slotType == null ? "NORMAL" : slotType.trim().toUpperCase();
 100	 String key;

 102	 case "EXPERT":

 105	 case "VIP":
 106	 key = "FEE_VIP";
 107	 break;
 108	 default:
 109	 key = "FEE_NORMAL";
 110	 }
 111	 BigDecimal fee = systemConfigService.getDecimalOrDefault(key, new BigDecimal("0.00"));
 112	 appointment.setFee(fee);
 113

 117	 appointment.setActualFee(actualFee);
 118	 }

 122	 if (appointment.getFee() == null) {

 240	 // 将患者重新加入候补队列

 246	 newAppointment.setFee(prepaymentOrder.getOriginalFee());
 247	 newAppointment.setActualFee(prepaymentOrder.getActualFee());

 249	 // 8. 入库预约记录
 250	 appointmentMapper.insert(newAppointment);

 252	 // 9. 消费预支付订单
 253	 try {

 42	 /** [重构] 加入候补队列 (使用 Redis ZSET) */
 43	 public void addToQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 44	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 45	 if (schedule == null) {
 46	 throw new CustomerException("排班不存在");
 47	 }
 48	 if (schedule.getAvailableSlots() != null && schedule.getAvailableSlots() > 0) {
 49	 throw new CustomerException("当前仍有号源，可直接预约");
 50	 }
 51	
 52	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 53	
 54	 // 检查是否已在队列中 (score不为null说明已存在)
 55	 Double score = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().score(key, patientId);
 56	 if (score != null) {
 57	 throw new CustomerException("已在候补队列中，请勿重复提交");
 58	 }
 59	
 60	 // 1. 加入 ZSET，分数为当前时间戳
 61	 long joinTime = new Date().getTime();
 62	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().add(key, patientId, (double) joinTime);
 63	
 64	 // 2. 额外维护一个反向索引 (用于 "我的候补" 查询)
 65	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 66	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().add(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 67	 }
 68	
 69	 /** [重构] 弹出队首 (从 ZSET 中弹出分数最低的) */
 70	 public Long popNext(Long scheduleId) {
 71	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 72	
 73	 // 弹出分数最低（即最早加入）的 1 个元素
 74	 // 注意: popMin 返回一个包含 TypedTuple 的 Set，我们需要从中提取值
 75	 Set<Object> result = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().popMin(key, 1)
 76	 .stream()
 77	 .map(tuple -> ((org.springframework.data.redis.core.ZSetOperations.TypedTuple<Object>) tuple).getValue())
 78	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 79	
 80	 if (result.isEmpty()) {
 81	 return null; // 队列为空
 82	 }
 83	
 84	 // (注意: 序列化配置会导致这里可能是Integer或String)
 85	 // 确保使用 Long 类型
 86	 Long patientId = ((Number) result.iterator().next()).longValue();
 87	
 88	 // 3. (清理) 从该患者的反向索引中移除这个排班
 89	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 90	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 91	
 92	 return patientId;
 93	 }

 47	 * 创建候补预支付订单
 48	 * @param patientId 患者ID
 49	 * @param scheduleId 排班ID
 50	 * @param waitlistId 候补记录ID
 51	 * @return 创建的预支付订单
 52	 */
 53	 @Transactional
 54	 public PrepaymentOrder createWaitlistPrepayment(Long patientId, Long scheduleId, Long waitlistId) {
 55	 // 1. 检查候补记录是否存在
 56	 Waitlist waitlist = waitlistMapper.selectById(waitlistId);
 57	 if (waitlist == null) {
 58	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录不存在");
 59	 }
 60	 
 61	 // 2. 检查患者ID是否匹配
 62	 if (!waitlist.getPatientId().equals(patientId)) {
 63	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录与患者不匹配");
 64	 }
 65	 
 66	 // 3. 检查排班ID是否匹配
 67	 if (!waitlist.getScheduleId().equals(scheduleId)) {
 68	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录与排班不匹配");
 69	 }
 70	 
 71	 // 4. 检查是否已经存在预支付订单
 72	 PrepaymentOrder existingOrder = prepaymentOrderMapper.selectByWaitlistId(waitlistId);
 73	 if (existingOrder != null) {
 74	 // 如果订单已过期，则可以重新创建
 75	 if ("EXPIRED".equals(existingOrder.getStatus())) {
 76	 prepaymentOrderMapper.delete(existingOrder.getId());
 77	 } else {
 78	 return existingOrder; // 返回已存在的订单
 79	 }
 80	 }
 81	 
 82	 // 5. 获取排班信息，计算费用
 83	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 84	 if (schedule == null) {
 85	 throw new CustomerException("排班信息不存在");
 86	 }
 87	 
 88	 // 6. 计算原始费用和实际费用
 89	 BigDecimal originalFee = calculateOriginalFee(schedule.getSlotType());
 90	 BigDecimal actualFee = calculateActualFee(patientId, originalFee);
 91	 
 92	 // 7. 生成订单号
 93	 String orderNo = generateOrderNo();
 94	 
 95	 // 8. 设置过期时间（默认30分钟）
 96	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 97	 calendar.add(Calendar.MINUTE, 30);
 98	 Date expireTime = calendar.getTime();
 99	 
 100	 // 9. 创建预支付订单
 101	 PrepaymentOrder order = new PrepaymentOrder();
 102	 order.setOrderNo(orderNo);
 103	 order.setPatientId(patientId);
 104	 order.setScheduleId(scheduleId);
 105	 order.setWaitlistId(waitlistId);
 106	 order.setOrderType("WAITLIST");
 107	 order.setOriginalFee(originalFee);
 108	 order.setActualFee(actualFee);
 109	 order.setPaidAmount(BigDecimal.ZERO);
 110	 order.setStatus("PENDING");
 111	 order.setExpireTime(expireTime);
 112	 order.setCreatedAt(new Date());
 113	 order.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
 114	 
 115	 // 10. 保存订单
 116	 prepaymentOrderMapper.insert(order);
 117	 
 118	 return order;
 119	 }

 126				checkAppointmentTimer: null, // 检查预约的定时器
 127				// 医生信息
 128				doctorInfo: {
 129					id: null,
 130					name: '',
 131					title: '',

 133				},
 134				// 排班信息
 135				scheduleInfo: {

 137					timeSlot: '',
 138					timeSlotDisplay: ''
 139				},
 140				// 候补信息

 142					rank: undefined,
 143					queueSize: 0
 144				},
 145				// 上次检查的候补状态
 146				lastWaitlistStatus: null,
 147				// 检查预约的间隔（毫秒）
 148				checkInterval: 10000, // 10秒
 149				// 最大检查次数
 150				maxCheckCount: 30, // 最多检查5分钟
 151				currentCheckCount: 0
 152			};

 154		onLoad(options) {
 155			console.log('候补页面参数:', options);
 156			
 157			// 检查是否已登录
 158			const token = this.$store.state.user.token;
 159			if (!token) {
 160				uni.showToast({ title: '请先登录', icon: 'none' });
 161				// 延迟跳转到登录页面
 162				setTimeout(() => {
 163					uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login' });
 164				}, 1000);
 165				return;
 166			}
 167			
 168			if (options.scheduleId) {
 169				this.scheduleId = parseInt(options.scheduleId);
 170			}
 171			
 172			if (options.doctorId) {
 173				this.doctorId = parseInt(options.doctorId);
 174			}
 175			
 176			if (options.scheduleDate) {
 177				this.scheduleDate = options.scheduleDate;
 178				this.scheduleInfo.date = options.scheduleDate;
 179			}
 180			
 181			if (options.timeSlot) {
 182				this.timeSlot = options.timeSlot;
 183				this.scheduleInfo.timeSlot = options.timeSlot;
 184				
 185				// 设置时间段显示文本
 186				const timeSlotMap = {
 187					'morning': '上午',
 188					'afternoon': '下午',
 189					'evening': '晚上'
 190				};
 191				this.scheduleInfo.timeSlotDisplay = timeSlotMap[options.timeSlot] || options.timeSlot;
 192			}
 193			
 194			// 加载候补信息
 195			this.loadWaitlistInfo();
 196			
 197			// 启动定时刷新（每30秒刷新一次）
 198			this.startAutoRefresh();
 199		},
 200		onUnload() {
 201			// 清除所有定时器
 202			if (this.refreshTimer) {
 203				clearInterval(this.refreshTimer);
 204				this.refreshTimer = null;
 205			}
 206			if (this.checkAppointmentTimer) {
 207				clearInterval(this.checkAppointmentTimer);
 208				this.checkAppointmentTimer = null;
 209			}
 210		},
 211		methods: {
 212			// 加载候补信息
 213			async loadWaitlistInfo(silent = false) {
 214				if (!silent) {
 215					this.loading = true;
 216				}
 217				try {
 218					// 获取我的候补列表
 219					const waitlistData = await getMyWaitlist({ silent: true });
 220					console.log('候补列表数据:', waitlistData);
 221	
 222					// 查找当前排班的候补信息
 223					let currentWaitlist = null;
 224					if (Array.isArray(waitlistData) && this.scheduleId) {
 225						currentWaitlist = waitlistData.find(item => item.scheduleId === this.scheduleId);
 226						if (currentWaitlist) {
 227							this.waitlistInfo.rank = currentWaitlist.rank;
 228							this.waitlistInfo.queueSize = currentWaitlist.queueSize;
 229						}
 230					}
 231	
 232					// 检测候补状态变化
 233					await this.checkWaitlistSuccess(currentWaitlist);
 234	
 235					// 通过排班ID获取详细信息（包含医生、科室等）
 236					if (this.scheduleId) {
 237						try {
 238							const scheduleDetails = await getScheduleDetailsById(this.scheduleId);
 239							console.log('排班详细信息:', scheduleDetails);
 240	
 241							if (scheduleDetails) {
 242								// 设置医生信息
 243								this.doctorInfo.id = scheduleDetails.doctorId;
 244								this.doctorInfo.name = scheduleDetails.doctorName || '未知医生';
 245								this.doctorInfo.title = ''; // 排班信息中没有职称，需要时可以额外查询
 246								this.doctorInfo.clinicName = scheduleDetails.departmentName || '未知科室';
 247	
 248								// 设置排班信息
 249								this.scheduleInfo.date = this.formatDate(scheduleDetails.scheduleDate);
 250								this.scheduleInfo.timeSlot = scheduleDetails.timeSlot;
 251	
 252								// 设置时间段显示文本
 253								const timeSlotMap = {
 254									'morning': '上午',
 255									'afternoon': '下午',
 256									'evening': '晚上'
 257								};
 258								const lowerCaseTimeSlot = scheduleDetails.timeSlot ? scheduleDetails.timeSlot.toLowerCase() : '';
 259								this.scheduleInfo.timeSlotDisplay = timeSlotMap[lowerCaseTimeSlot] || scheduleDetails.timeSlot;
 260							}
 261						} catch (e) {
 262							console.error('获取排班详细信息失败:', e);
 263							// 如果获取失败，保留原有的参数信息
 264						}
 265					}
 266				} catch (e) {
 267					console.error('加载候补信息失败:', e);
 268					uni.showToast({
 269						title: e.msg || '加载失败',
 270						icon: 'none'
 271					});
 272				} finally {
 273					if (!silent) {
 274						this.loading = false;
 275					}
 276				}
 277			},
 278	
 279			// 检测候补状态变化
 280			async checkWaitlistSuccess(currentWaitlist) {
 281				// 记录当前候补状态
 282				const currentStatus = currentWaitlist ? 'waiting' : 'none';
 283	
 284				// 第一次检测，只记录状态
 285				if (this.lastWaitlistStatus === null) {
 286					this.lastWaitlistStatus = currentStatus;
 287					console.log('初始化候补状态:', currentStatus);
 288	
 289					// 如果有候补记录，启动预约检查定时器
 290					if (currentWaitlist) {
 291						this.startAppointmentCheck();
 292					}
 293					return;
 294				}
 295	
 296				// 检测候补记录消失
 297				if (this.lastWaitlistStatus === 'waiting' && currentStatus === 'none') {
 298					console.log('检测到候补记录消失');
 299	
 300					// 停止所有定时器
 301					this.stopAllTimers();
 302	
 303					// 检查是否有新预约
 304					const hasAppointment = await this.checkForNewAppointment();
 305	
 306					if (hasAppointment) {
 307						console.log('✅ 候补成功！已找到新预约');
 308						this.handleWaitlistSuccess();
 309					} else {
 310						console.log('❌ 候补记录消失但未找到新预约（可能是手动退出）');
 311						// 返回上一页
 312						setTimeout(() => {
 313							uni.navigateBack();
 314						}, 1000);
 315					}
 316				}
 317	
 318				// 更新状态
 319				this.lastWaitlistStatus = currentStatus;
 320			},
 321	
 322			// 启动预约检查定时器
 323			startAppointmentCheck() {
 324				console.log('启动预约检查定时器，每', this.checkInterval / 1000, '秒检查一次');
 325	
 326				// 清除旧的定时器
 327				if (this.checkAppointmentTimer) {
 328					clearInterval(this.checkAppointmentTimer);
 329				}
 330	
 331				// 启动新的定时器
 332				this.checkAppointmentTimer = setInterval(async () => {
 333					this.currentCheckCount++;
 334					console.log(`第 ${this.currentCheckCount} 次检查预约...`);
 335	
 336					// 达到最大检查次数
 337					if (this.currentCheckCount >= this.maxCheckCount) {
 338						console.log('达到最大检查次数，停止检查');
 339						this.stopAllTimers();
 340						return;
 341					}
 342	
 343					// 检查是否有新预约
 344					const hasAppointment = await this.checkForNewAppointment();
 345					if (hasAppointment) {
 346						console.log('✅ 检测到新预约！候补成功');
 347						this.stopAllTimers();
 348						this.handleWaitlistSuccess();
 349					}
 350				}, this.checkInterval);
 351			},
 352	
 353			// 检查是否有新预约
 354			async checkForNewAppointment() {
 355				try {
 356					const data = await request({ url: '/appointment/me', method: 'GET', silent: true });
 357					const appointments = Array.isArray(data) ? data : ((data && data.list) ? data.list : []);
 358	
 359					console.log('当前预约列表:', appointments);
 360	
 361					// 查找匹配的预约：scheduleId匹配 且 来源是候补
 362					const newAppointment = appointments.find(apt => {
 363						const match = apt.scheduleId === this.scheduleId && apt.sourceType === 'WAITLIST';
 364						if (match) {
 365							console.log('找到匹配的预约:', apt);
 366						}
 367						return match;
 368					});
 369	
 370					return !!newAppointment;
 371				} catch (err) {
 372					console.error('检查预约失败:', err);
 373					return false;
 374				}
 375			},
 376	
 377			// 停止所有定时器
 378			stopAllTimers() {
 379				if (this.refreshTimer) {
 380					clearInterval(this.refreshTimer);
 381					this.refreshTimer = null;
 382				}
 383				if (this.checkAppointmentTimer) {
 384					clearInterval(this.checkAppointmentTimer);
 385					this.checkAppointmentTimer = null;
 386				}
 387			},
 388	
 389			// 处理候补成功
 390			handleWaitlistSuccess() {
 391				// 写入消息中心
 392				this.addSuccessMessage();
 393	
 394				// 显示成功弹窗
 395				this.showSuccessModal();
 396			},
 397	
 398			// 添加成功消息到消息中心
 399			addSuccessMessage() {
 400				try {
 401					const messages = uni.getStorageSync('user_messages') || [];
 402					const newMessage = {
 403						id: Date.now(),
 404						type: 'waitlist_success',
 405						title: '候补成功',
 406						content: `您的候补已成功转为预约，医生：${this.doctorInfo.name || '未知医生'}，时间：${this.scheduleInfo.date} ${this.scheduleInfo.timeSlotDisplay}`,
 407						time: new Date().toISOString(),
 408						read: false
 409					};
 410					messages.unshift(newMessage);
 411					// 只保留最近50条消息
 412					if (messages.length > 50) {
 413						messages.splice(50);
 414					}
 415					uni.setStorageSync('user_messages', messages);
 416					console.log('候补成功消息已写入消息中心');
 417				} catch (e) {
 418					console.error('写入消息中心失败:', e);
 419				}
 420			},
 421	
 422			// 显示候补成功弹窗
 423			showSuccessModal() {
 424				uni.showModal({
 425					title: ' 候补成功',
 426					content: '您的候补已成功转为预约！请前往就诊记录查看详情，或稍后查看消息通知。',
 427					confirmText: '查看记录',
 428					cancelText: '稍后查看',
 429					success: (res) => {
 430						if (res.confirm) {
 431							// 通过全局数据传递参数，因为switchTab不支持URL参数
 432							getApp().globalData.waitlistSuccess = {
 433								from: 'waitlist_success',
 434								scheduleId: this.scheduleId,
 435								timestamp: Date.now()
 436							};
 437							// 跳转到记录页面
 438							uni.switchTab({
 439								url: '/pages/records/records'
 440							});
 441						} else {
 442							// 返回上一页
 443							uni.navigateBack();
 444						}
 445					}
 446				});
 447			},
 448	
 449			// 启动自动刷新
 450			startAutoRefresh() {
 451				console.log('启动自动刷新，每30秒刷新一次候补状态');
 452				// 每30秒刷新一次数据，使用静默模式
 453				this.refreshTimer = setInterval(() => {
 454					this.loadWaitlistInfo(true); // 静默刷新
 455				}, 30000);
 456			},
 457	
 458			// 手动刷新数据
 459			async refreshData() {
 460				uni.showLoading({ title: '刷新中...' });
 461				await this.loadWaitlistInfo(false); // 非静默刷新
 462				uni.hideLoading();
 463				uni.showToast({
 464					title: '刷新成功',
 465					icon: 'success',
 466					duration: 1500
 467				});
 468			},
 469	
 470			// 取消候补
 471			handleCancelWaitlist() {
 472				uni.showModal({
 473					title: '取消候补',
 474					content: '确定要取消候补吗？取消后无法恢复，需重新排队',
 475					confirmText: '确认取消',
 476					confirmColor: '#f44336',
 477					success: async (res) => {
 478						if (res.confirm) {
 479							await this.cancelWaitlist();
 480						}
 481					}
 482				});
 483			},
 484	
 485			// 提交取消候补
 486			async cancelWaitlist() {
 487				if (!this.scheduleId) {
 488					uni.showToast({
 489						title: '缺少排班信息',
 490						icon: 'none'
 491					});
 492					return;
 493				}
 494	
 495				this.loading = true;
 496				try {
 497					// 调用取消候补API
 498					await cancelWaitlist(this.scheduleId);
 499	
 500					uni.showToast({
 501						title: '已取消候补',
 502						icon: 'success'
 503					});
 504	
 505					// 返回上一页
 506					setTimeout(() => {
 507						uni.navigateBack();
 508					}, 1500);
 509				} catch (e) {
 510					console.error('取消候补失败:', e);
 511					uni.showToast({
 512						title: e.msg || '取消失败',
 513						icon: 'none'
 514					});
 515				} finally {
 516					this.loading = false;
 517				}
 518			},
 519	
 520			// 格式化日期
 521			formatDate(dateStr) {
 522				if (!dateStr) return '';
 523				const date = new Date(dateStr);
 524				const year = date.getFullYear();
 525				const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
 526				const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
 527				return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
 528			}
 529		}
 530	};

 1	package com.example.springboot.schedule;

 3	import com.example.springboot.service.PrepaymentOrderService;
 4	import jakarta.annotation.Resource;
 5	import org.slf4j.Logger;
 6	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 7	import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
 8	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 9	
 10	/**
 11	 * 预支付订单定时任务
 12	 * 处理过期订单和需要退款的订单
 13	 */
 14	@Component
 15	public class PrepaymentOrderScheduleTask {
 16	 private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PrepaymentOrderScheduleTask.class);
 17	
 18	 @Resource
 19	 private PrepaymentOrderService prepaymentOrderService;
 20	
 21	 /**
 22	 * 每5分钟处理一次过期订单
 23	 * 将状态为PENDING且已过期的订单状态更新为EXPIRED
 24	 */
 25	 @Scheduled(fixedRate = 300000) // 5分钟 = 300000毫秒
 26	 public void processExpiredOrders() {
 27	 try {
 28	 logger.info("开始处理过期订单");
 29	 prepaymentOrderService.processExpiredOrders();
 30	 logger.info("过期订单处理完成");
 31	 } catch (Exception e) {
 32	 logger.error("处理过期订单失败: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
 33	 }
 34	 }
 35	
 36	 /**
 37	 * 每10分钟处理一次需要退款的订单
 38	 * 将状态为PAID且对应候补记录状态为EXPIRED或CANCELLED的订单进行退款
 39	 */
 40	 @Scheduled(fixedRate = 600000) // 10分钟 = 600000毫秒
 41	 public void processRefundOrders() {
 42	 try {
 43	 logger.info("开始处理需要退款的订单");
 44	 prepaymentOrderService.processRefundOrders();
 45	 logger.info("退款订单处理完成");
 46	 } catch (Exception e) {
 47	 logger.error("处理退款订单失败: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
 48	 }
 49	 }
 50	}

 29	 public List<ScheduleDTO> getWeekSchedule() {
 30	 // 获取当前日期
 31	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 32	 calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
 33	 calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
 34	 calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
 35	 calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
 36	 Date startDate = calendar.getTime();
 37	
 38	 // 获取一周后的日期
 39	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 7);
 40	 Date endDate = calendar.getTime();
 41	
 42	 // 查询数据库
 43	 List<Schedule> schedules = scheduleMapper.selectSchedulesByDateRange(startDate, endDate);
 44	
 45	 // 转换为DTO并添加星期几信息
 46	 List<ScheduleDTO> scheduleDTOs = new ArrayList<>();
 47	 for (Schedule schedule : schedules) {
 48	 ScheduleDTO dto = new ScheduleDTO();
 49	 BeanUtils.copyProperties(schedule, dto);
 50	
 51	 // 获取星期几
 52	 calendar.setTime(schedule.getScheduleDate());
 53	 int dayOfWeek = calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK) - 1;
 54	 dto.setDayOfWeek(DAYS_OF_WEEK[dayOfWeek]);
 55	
 56	 scheduleDTOs.add(dto);
 57	 }
 58	
 59	 return scheduleDTOs;
 60	 }

 67	 @Transactional
 68	 public Schedule createSchedule(CreateScheduleRequest request) {
 69	 // 1. 验证医生是否存在
 70	 if (doctorMapper.selectById(request.getDoctorId()) == null) {
 71	 throw new RuntimeException("医生不存在");
 72	 }
 73	
 74	 // 2. 检查是否已存在相同的排班
 75	 int exists = scheduleMapper.checkScheduleExists(
 76	 request.getDoctorId(),
 77	 request.getScheduleDate(),
 78	 request.getTimeSlot()
 79	 );
 80	 if (exists > 0) {
 81	 throw new RuntimeException("该时间段已存在排班，请勿重复创建");
 82	 }
 83	
 84	 // 3. 创建排班记录
 85	 Schedule schedule = new Schedule();
 86	 schedule.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
 87	 schedule.setScheduleDate(request.getScheduleDate());
 88	 schedule.setTimeSlot(request.getTimeSlot());
 89	 schedule.setSlotType(request.getSlotType());
 90	 schedule.setTotalSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 91	
 92	 // 如果没有指定可用号源数，则默认等于总号源数
 93	 if (request.getAvailableSlots() != null) {
 94	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getAvailableSlots());
 95	 } else {
 96	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 97	 }
 98	
 99	 scheduleMapper.insert(schedule);
 100	 return schedule;
 101	 }

 106	 @Transactional
 107	 public Map<String, Object> batchCreateSchedule(BatchScheduleRequest request) {
 108	 // 1. 验证医生是否存在
 109	 if (doctorMapper.selectById(request.getDoctorId()) == null) {
 110	 throw new RuntimeException("医生不存在");
 111	 }
 112	
 113	 // 2. 验证日期范围
 114	 if (request.getEndDate().before(request.getStartDate())) {
 115	 throw new RuntimeException("结束日期不能早于开始日期");
 116	 }
 117	
 118	 // 3. 生成日期列表
 119	 List<Date> dateList = generateDateList(
 120	 request.getStartDate(),
 121	 request.getEndDate(),
 122	 request.getSkipWeekends(),
 123	 request.getExcludeDates()
 124	 );
 125	
 126	 // 4. 批量创建排班
 127	 int successCount = 0;
 128	 int skipCount = 0;
 129	 List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();
 130	
 131	 for (Date date : dateList) {
 132	 for (String timeSlot : request.getTimeSlots()) {
 133	 try {
 134	 // 检查是否已存在
 135	 int exists = scheduleMapper.checkScheduleExists(
 136	 request.getDoctorId(), date, timeSlot
 137	 );
 138	 if (exists > 0) {
 139	 skipCount++;
 140	 continue;
 141	 }
 142	
 143	 // 创建排班
 144	 Schedule schedule = new Schedule();
 145	 schedule.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
 146	 schedule.setScheduleDate(date);
 147	 schedule.setTimeSlot(timeSlot);
 148	 schedule.setSlotType(request.getSlotType());
 149	 schedule.setTotalSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 150	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 151	
 152	 scheduleMapper.insert(schedule);
 153	 successCount++;
 154	 } catch (Exception e) {
 155	 errors.add(String.format("日期 %s 时段 %s 创建失败: %s", date, timeSlot, e.getMessage()));
 156	 }
 157	 }
 158	 }
 159	
 160	 // 5. 返回结果
 161	 Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
 162	 result.put("successCount", successCount);
 163	 result.put("skipCount", skipCount);
 164	 result.put("errorCount", errors.size());
 165	 result.put("errors", errors);
 166	 result.put("message", String.format("成功创建 %d 个排班，跳过 %d 个已存在的排班", successCount, skipCount));
 167	
 168	 return result;
 169	 }

 258	 public Map<String, Object> querySchedules(ScheduleQueryRequest request) {
 259	 // 1. 条件查询
 260	 List<ScheduleWithDetailsDTO> schedules = scheduleMapper.selectByConditions(
 261	 request.getDoctorId(),
 262	 request.getDepartmentId(),
 263	 request.getStartDate(),
 264	 request.getEndDate(),
 265	 request.getTimeSlot(),
 266	 request.getSlotType()
 267	 );
 268	
 269	 // 2. 统计总数
 270	 int total = scheduleMapper.countByConditions(
 271	 request.getDoctorId(),
 272	 request.getDepartmentId(),
 273	 request.getStartDate(),
 274	 request.getEndDate(),
 275	 request.getTimeSlot(),
 276	 request.getSlotType()
 277	 );
 278	
 279	 // 3. 分页处理
 280	 int page = request.getPage();
 281	 int pageSize = request.getPageSize();
 282	 int startIndex = (page - 1) * pageSize;
 283	 int endIndex = Math.min(startIndex + pageSize, schedules.size());
 284	
 285	 List<ScheduleWithDetailsDTO> pagedSchedules = schedules.subList(startIndex, endIndex);
 286	
 287	 // 4. 返回结果
 288	 Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
 289	 result.put("list", pagedSchedules);
 290	 result.put("total", total);
 291	 result.put("page", page);
 292	 result.put("pageSize", pageSize);
 293	 result.put("totalPages", (total + pageSize - 1) / pageSize);
 294	
 295	 return result;
 296	 }

 312	 /**
 313	 * 生成日期列表（批量创建排班时使用）
 314	 */
 315	 private List<Date> generateDateList(Date startDate, Date endDate, Boolean skipWeekends, List<Date> excludeDates) {
 316	 List<Date> dateList = new ArrayList<>();
 317	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 318	 calendar.setTime(startDate);
 319	 calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
 320	 calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
 321	 calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
 322	 calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
 323	
 324	 while (!calendar.getTime().after(endDate)) {
 325	 Date currentDate = calendar.getTime();
 326	
 327	 // 检查是否需要跳过周末
 328	 if (skipWeekends != null && skipWeekends) {
 329	 int dayOfWeek = calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 330	 if (dayOfWeek == Calendar.SATURDAY || dayOfWeek == Calendar.SUNDAY) {
 331	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 332	 continue;
 333	 }
 334	 }
 335	
 336	 // 检查是否在排除日期中
 337	 boolean isExcluded = false;
 338	 if (excludeDates != null) {
 339	 for (Date excludeDate : excludeDates) {
 340	 Calendar excludeCal = Calendar.getInstance();
 341	 excludeCal.setTime(excludeDate);
 342	 if (calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.YEAR) &&
 343	 calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR)) {
 344	 isExcluded = true;
 345	 break;
 346	 }
 347	 }
 348	 }
 349	
 350	 if (!isExcluded) {
 351	 dateList.add(currentDate);
 352	 }
 353	
 354	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 355	 }
 356	
 357	 return dateList;
 358	 }

 360	 /**
 361	 * 加号（增加号源数量），并自动处理候补队列
 362	 */
 363	 @Transactional
 364	 public Map<String, Object> addSlots(Long id, Integer slotsToAdd) {
 365	 // 1. 查询排班
 366	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(id);
 367	 if (schedule == null) {
 368	 throw new RuntimeException("排班不存在");
 369	 }
 370	
 371	 // 2. 更新号源数量
 372	 schedule.setTotalSlots(schedule.getTotalSlots() + slotsToAdd);
 373	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(schedule.getAvailableSlots() + slotsToAdd);
 374	 scheduleMapper.updateById(schedule);
 375	
 376	 // 3. 循环处理候补队列，直到新增的号源被用完或候补队列为空
 377	 int filledCount = 0;
 378	 for (int i = 0; i < slotsToAdd; i++) {
 379	 boolean filled = appointmentService.processNextInWaitlist(id);
 380	 if (filled) {
 381	 filledCount++;
 382	 } else {
 383	 // 候补队列已空，无需继续
 384	 break;
 385	 }
 386	 }
 387	
 388	 // 4. 准备返回结果
 389	 Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
 390	 result.put("schedule", scheduleMapper.selectById(id)); // 返回最新的排班信息
 391	 result.put("filledFromWaitlist", filledCount);
 392	 result.put("message", String.format("成功增加 %d 个号源，并自动为 %d 位候补患者创建了预约。", slotsToAdd, filledCount));
 393	
 394	 return result;
 395	 }

 35	 // 定义 Redis Key 的前缀
 36	 // 候补队列 (ZSET): "waitlist:schedule:{scheduleId}" -> ZSET [ patientId, joinTime ]
 37	 private static final String WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX = "waitlist:schedule:";
 38	 // 患者的候补列表 (SET): "waitlist:patient:{patientId}" -> SET [ "scheduleId1", "scheduleId2" ]
 39	 private static final String PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX = "waitlist:patient:";

 42	 /** [重构] 加入候补队列 (使用 Redis ZSET) */
 43	 public void addToQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 44	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 45	 if (schedule == null) {
 46	 throw new CustomerException("排班不存在");
 47	 }
 48	 if (schedule.getAvailableSlots() != null && schedule.getAvailableSlots() > 0) {
 49	 throw new CustomerException("当前仍有号源，可直接预约");
 50	 }
 51	
 52	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 53	
 54	 // 检查是否已在队列中 (score不为null说明已存在)
 55	 Double score = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().score(key, patientId);
 56	 if (score != null) {
 57	 throw new CustomerException("已在候补队列中，请勿重复提交");
 58	 }
 59	
 60	 // 1. 加入 ZSET，分数为当前时间戳
 61	 long joinTime = new Date().getTime();
 62	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().add(key, patientId, (double) joinTime);
 63	
 64	 // 2. 额外维护一个反向索引 (用于 "我的候补" 查询)
 65	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 66	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().add(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 67	 }
 68	
 69	 /** [重构] 弹出队首 (从 ZSET 中弹出分数最低的) */
 70	 public Long popNext(Long scheduleId) {
 71	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 72	
 73	 // 弹出分数最低（即最早加入）的 1 个元素
 74	 // 注意: popMin 返回一个包含 TypedTuple 的 Set，我们需要从中提取值
 75	 Set<Object> result = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().popMin(key, 1)
 76	 .stream()
 77	 .map(tuple -> ((org.springframework.data.redis.core.ZSetOperations.TypedTuple<Object>) tuple).getValue())
 78	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 79	
 80	 if (result.isEmpty()) {
 81	 return null; // 队列为空
 82	 }
 83	
 84	 // (注意: 序列化配置会导致这里可能是Integer或String)
 85	 // 确保使用 Long 类型
 86	 Long patientId = ((Number) result.iterator().next()).longValue();
 87	
 88	 // 3. (清理) 从该患者的反向索引中移除这个排班
 89	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 90	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 91	
 92	 return patientId;
 93	 }

 96	 public List<WaitlistInfoDTO> listByPatient(Long patientId) {
 97	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 98	
 99	 // 1. 获取该患者候补的所有 scheduleId
 100	 Set<Object> scheduleIdObjects = redisTemplate.opsForSet().members(patientKey);
 101	 if (scheduleIdObjects == null || scheduleIdObjects.isEmpty()) {
 102	 return List.of(); // 返回空列表
 103	 }
 104	
 105	 // 2. 遍历，查询每个队列中该 patientId 的排名，并补充展示所需信息
 106	 return scheduleIdObjects.stream()
 107	 .map(obj -> {
 108	 if (!(obj instanceof Number) && !(obj instanceof String)) {
 109	 return null;
 110	 }
 111	 try {
 112	 Long scheduleId = Long.valueOf(String.valueOf(obj));
 113	 String queueKey = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 114	
 115	 Long rank = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().rank(queueKey, patientId);
 116	 Long queueSize = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().size(queueKey);
 117	 if (rank == null) {
 118	 return null;
 119	 }
 120	
 121	 WaitlistInfoDTO dto = new WaitlistInfoDTO(scheduleId, rank, queueSize);
 122	
 123	 // 额外补充：医生与排班信息
 124	 Schedule s = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 125	 if (s != null) {
 126	 dto.setScheduleDate(s.getScheduleDate());
 127	 dto.setTimeSlot(s.getTimeSlot());
 128	 dto.setTimeSlotName(timeSlotToCn(s.getTimeSlot()));
 129	 dto.setDoctorId(s.getDoctorId());
 130	 try {
 131	 Doctor d = doctorMapper.selectById(s.getDoctorId());
 132	 if (d != null) dto.setDoctorName(d.getName());
 133	 } catch (Exception ignored) {}
 134	 }
 135	 return dto;
 136	 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
 137	 System.err.println("Invalid scheduleId format in Redis set: " + obj);
 138	 return null;
 139	 }
 140	 })
 141	 .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull)
 142	 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 143	 }

 151	 // 2. 从患者的反向索引 SET 中移除 scheduleId
 152	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 153	 }

 58	 // ========== 规则校验 ==========
 59	 var schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(appointment.getScheduleId());
 60	 if (schedule == null) {
 61	 throw new CustomerException("排班不存在");
 62	 }

 64	 // 预约时间必须为未来时间，且与排班日期一致
 65	 Date now = new Date();
 66	 if (appointment.getAppointmentTime() == null || !appointment.getAppointmentTime().after(now)) {
 67	 throw new CustomerException("预约时间必须为未来时间");
 68	 }
 69	 Date dayStart = atStartOfDay(schedule.getScheduleDate());
 70	 Date dayEnd = atStartOfNextDay(schedule.getScheduleDate());
 71	 if (appointment.getAppointmentTime().before(dayStart) || !appointment.getAppointmentTime().before(dayEnd)) {
 72	 throw new CustomerException("预约时间与排班日期不一致");
 73	 }
 74	
 75	 // 每个患者每天最多预约N次（默认3）
 76	 Long patientId = appointment.getPatientId();
 77	 int dailyLimit = systemConfigService.getIntOrDefault("APPOINTMENT_DAILY_LIMIT", 3);
 78	 int todayCount = appointmentMapper.countByPatientAndDate(patientId, dayStart, dayEnd);
 79	 if (todayCount >= dailyLimit) {
 80	 throw new CustomerException("当天预约次数已达上限");
 81	 }
 82	
 83	 // 同一排班禁止重复预约
 84	 int exists = appointmentMapper.existsByPatientAndSchedule(patientId, appointment.getScheduleId());
 85	 if (exists > 0) {
 86	 throw new CustomerException("请勿重复预约该排班");
 87	 }
 88	
 89	 // ========== 扣减号源（原子性） ==========
 90	 int decreased = scheduleMapper.decreaseAvailableSlots(schedule.getId());
 91	 if (decreased <= 0) {
 92	 throw new CustomerException("号源不足");
 93	 }
 94	
 95	 // ========== 费用计算 ==========
 96	 try {
 97	 if (appointment.getFee() == null || appointment.getFee().compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0) {

 100	 String key;

 106	 key = "FEE_VIP";

 108	 default:

 117	 appointment.setActualFee(actualFee);
 118	 }

 122	 if (appointment.getFee() == null) {

 125	 if (appointment.getActualFee() == null) {
 126	 appointment.setActualFee(appointment.getFee());

 246	 newAppointment.setFee(prepaymentOrder.getOriginalFee());
 247	 newAppointment.setActualFee(prepaymentOrder.getActualFee());

 250	 appointmentMapper.insert(newAppointment);

 253	 try {
 254	 prepaymentOrderService.consumeOrder(prepaymentOrder.getWaitlistId());

 42	 /** [重构] 加入候补队列 (使用 Redis ZSET) */
 43	 public void addToQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 44	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 45	 if (schedule == null) {
 46	 throw new CustomerException("排班不存在");
 47	 }
 48	 if (schedule.getAvailableSlots() != null && schedule.getAvailableSlots() > 0) {
 49	 throw new CustomerException("当前仍有号源，可直接预约");
 50	 }
 51	
 52	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 53	
 54	 // 检查是否已在队列中 (score不为null说明已存在)
 55	 Double score = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().score(key, patientId);
 56	 if (score != null) {
 57	 throw new CustomerException("已在候补队列中，请勿重复提交");
 58	 }
 59	
 60	 // 1. 加入 ZSET，分数为当前时间戳
 61	 long joinTime = new Date().getTime();
 62	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().add(key, patientId, (double) joinTime);
 63	
 64	 // 2. 额外维护一个反向索引 (用于 "我的候补" 查询)
 65	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 66	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().add(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 67	 }

 69	 /** [重构] 弹出队首 (从 ZSET 中弹出分数最低的) */
 70	 public Long popNext(Long scheduleId) {
 71	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 72	
 73	 // 弹出分数最低（即最早加入）的 1 个元素
 74	 // 注意: popMin 返回一个包含 TypedTuple 的 Set，我们需要从中提取值
 75	 Set<Object> result = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().popMin(key, 1)
 76	 .stream()
 77	 .map(tuple -> ((org.springframework.data.redis.core.ZSetOperations.TypedTuple<Object>) tuple).getValue())
 78	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 79	
 80	 if (result.isEmpty()) {
 81	 return null; // 队列为空
 82	 }
 83	
 84	 // (注意: 序列化配置会导致这里可能是Integer或String)
 85	 // 确保使用 Long 类型
 86	 Long patientId = ((Number) result.iterator().next()).longValue();
 87	
 88	 // 3. (清理) 从该患者的反向索引中移除这个排班
 89	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 90	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 91	
 92	 return patientId;
 93	 }

 47	 * 创建候补预支付订单
 48	 * @param patientId 患者ID

 53	 @Transactional
 54	 public PrepaymentOrder createWaitlistPrepayment(Long patientId, Long scheduleId, Long waitlistId) {
 55	 // 1. 检查候补记录是否存在
 56	 Waitlist waitlist = waitlistMapper.selectById(waitlistId);
 57	 if (waitlist == null) {
 58	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录不存在");
 59	 }
 60	 
 61	 // 2. 检查患者ID是否匹配
 62	 if (!waitlist.getPatientId().equals(patientId)) {
 63	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录与患者不匹配");
 64	 }
 65	 
 66	 // 3. 检查排班ID是否匹配
 67	 if (!waitlist.getScheduleId().equals(scheduleId)) {
 68	 throw new CustomerException("候补记录与排班不匹配");
 69	 }
 70	 
 71	 // 4. 检查是否已经存在预支付订单
 72	 PrepaymentOrder existingOrder = prepaymentOrderMapper.selectByWaitlistId(waitlistId);
 73	 if (existingOrder != null) {
 74	 // 如果订单已过期，则可以重新创建
 75	 if ("EXPIRED".equals(existingOrder.getStatus())) {
 76	 prepaymentOrderMapper.delete(existingOrder.getId());
 77	 } else {
 78	 return existingOrder; // 返回已存在的订单
 79	 }
 80	 }
 81	 
 82	 // 5. 获取排班信息，计算费用
 83	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 84	 if (schedule == null) {
 85	 throw new CustomerException("排班信息不存在");
 86	 }
 87	 
 88	 // 6. 计算原始费用和实际费用
 89	 BigDecimal originalFee = calculateOriginalFee(schedule.getSlotType());
 90	 BigDecimal actualFee = calculateActualFee(patientId, originalFee);
 91	 
 92	 // 7. 生成订单号
 93	 String orderNo = generateOrderNo();
 94	 
 95	 // 8. 设置过期时间（默认30分钟）
 96	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 97	 calendar.add(Calendar.MINUTE, 30);
 98	 Date expireTime = calendar.getTime();
 99	 
 100	 // 9. 创建预支付订单
 101	 PrepaymentOrder order = new PrepaymentOrder();
 102	 order.setOrderNo(orderNo);
 103	 order.setPatientId(patientId);
 104	 order.setScheduleId(scheduleId);
 105	 order.setWaitlistId(waitlistId);
 106	 order.setOrderType("WAITLIST");
 107	 order.setOriginalFee(originalFee);
 108	 order.setActualFee(actualFee);
 109	 order.setPaidAmount(BigDecimal.ZERO);
 110	 order.setStatus("PENDING");
 111	 order.setExpireTime(expireTime);
 112	 order.setCreatedAt(new Date());
 113	 order.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
 114	 
 115	 // 10. 保存订单
 116	 prepaymentOrderMapper.insert(order);
 117	 
 118	 return order;
 119	 }

 521			formatDate(dateStr) {

 10	/**

 13	 */
 14	@Component
 15	public class PrepaymentOrderScheduleTask {

 24	 */
 25	 @Scheduled(fixedRate = 300000) // 5分钟 = 300000毫秒
 26	 public void processExpiredOrders() {

 29	 prepaymentOrderService.processExpiredOrders();
 30	 logger.info("过期订单处理完成");

 33	 }
 34	 }

 39	 */
 40	 @Scheduled(fixedRate = 600000) // 10分钟 = 600000毫秒

 29	 public List<ScheduleDTO> getWeekSchedule() {

 36	 Date startDate = calendar.getTime();

 38	 // 获取一周后的日期

 44	
 45	 // 转换为DTO并添加星期几信息
 46	 List<ScheduleDTO> scheduleDTOs = new ArrayList<>();
 47	 for (Schedule schedule : schedules) {

 79	 );
 80	 if (exists > 0) {
 81	 throw new RuntimeException("该时间段已存在排班，请勿重复创建");
 82	 }
 83	
 84	 // 3. 创建排班记录
 85	 Schedule schedule = new Schedule();
 86	 schedule.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
 87	 schedule.setScheduleDate(request.getScheduleDate());
 88	 schedule.setTimeSlot(request.getTimeSlot());
 89	 schedule.setSlotType(request.getSlotType());
 90	 schedule.setTotalSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 91	
 92	 // 如果没有指定可用号源数，则默认等于总号源数
 93	 if (request.getAvailableSlots() != null) {
 94	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getAvailableSlots());
 95	 } else {
 96	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 97	 }

 99	 scheduleMapper.insert(schedule);

 131	 for (Date date : dateList) {
 132	 for (String timeSlot : request.getTimeSlots()) {
 133	 try {
 134	 // 检查是否已存在
 135	 int exists = scheduleMapper.checkScheduleExists(
 136	 request.getDoctorId(), date, timeSlot
 137	 );

 139	 skipCount++;
 140	 continue;
 141	 }
 142	
 143	 // 创建排班

 147	 schedule.setTimeSlot(timeSlot);
 148	 schedule.setSlotType(request.getSlotType());
 149	 schedule.setTotalSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 150	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 151	
 152	 scheduleMapper.insert(schedule);
 153	 successCount++;
 154	 } catch (Exception e) {
 155	 errors.add(String.format("日期 %s 时段 %s 创建失败: %s", date, timeSlot, e.getMessage()));
 156	 }
 157	 }

 266	 request.getSlotType()
 267	 );
 268	
 269	 // 2. 统计总数
 270	 int total = scheduleMapper.countByConditions(
 271	 request.getDoctorId(),
 272	 request.getDepartmentId(),
 273	 request.getStartDate(),
 274	 request.getEndDate(),
 275	 request.getTimeSlot(),
 276	 request.getSlotType()
 277	 );
 278	
 279	 // 3. 分页处理
 280	 int page = request.getPage();
 281	 int pageSize = request.getPageSize();
 282	 int startIndex = (page - 1) * pageSize;
 283	 int endIndex = Math.min(startIndex + pageSize, schedules.size());
 284	
 285	 List<ScheduleWithDetailsDTO> pagedSchedules = schedules.subList(startIndex, endIndex);
 286	
 287	 // 4. 返回结果
 288	 Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
 289	 result.put("list", pagedSchedules);
 290	 result.put("total", total);
 291	 result.put("page", page);
 292	 result.put("pageSize", pageSize);
 293	 result.put("totalPages", (total + pageSize - 1) / pageSize);
 294	
 295	 return result;

 312	 /**
 313	 * 生成日期列表（批量创建排班时使用）
 314	 */
 315	 private List<Date> generateDateList(Date startDate, Date endDate, Boolean skipWeekends, List<Date> excludeDates) {
 316	 List<Date> dateList = new ArrayList<>();
 317	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 318	 calendar.setTime(startDate);
 319	 calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
 320	 calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
 321	 calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
 322	 calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
 323	
 324	 while (!calendar.getTime().after(endDate)) {
 325	 Date currentDate = calendar.getTime();
 326	
 327	 // 检查是否需要跳过周末
 328	 if (skipWeekends != null && skipWeekends) {
 329	 int dayOfWeek = calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 330	 if (dayOfWeek == Calendar.SATURDAY || dayOfWeek == Calendar.SUNDAY) {
 331	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 332	 continue;
 333	 }
 334	 }
 335	
 336	 // 检查是否在排除日期中
 337	 boolean isExcluded = false;
 338	 if (excludeDates != null) {
 339	 for (Date excludeDate : excludeDates) {
 340	 Calendar excludeCal = Calendar.getInstance();
 341	 excludeCal.setTime(excludeDate);
 342	 if (calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.YEAR) &&
 343	 calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR)) {
 344	 isExcluded = true;
 345	 break;
 346	 }
 347	 }
 348	 }
 349	
 350	 if (!isExcluded) {
 351	 dateList.add(currentDate);
 352	 }
 353	
 354	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 355	 }
 356	
 357	 return dateList;
 358	 }

 360	 /**
 361	 * 加号（增加号源数量），并自动处理候补队列
 362	 */
 363	 @Transactional
 364	 public Map<String, Object> addSlots(Long id, Integer slotsToAdd) {
 365	 // 1. 查询排班
 366	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(id);
 367	 if (schedule == null) {
 368	 throw new RuntimeException("排班不存在");
 369	 }
 370	
 371	 // 2. 更新号源数量
 372	 schedule.setTotalSlots(schedule.getTotalSlots() + slotsToAdd);
 373	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(schedule.getAvailableSlots() + slotsToAdd);
 374	 scheduleMapper.updateById(schedule);
 375	
 376	 // 3. 循环处理候补队列，直到新增的号源被用完或候补队列为空
 377	 int filledCount = 0;
 378	 for (int i = 0; i < slotsToAdd; i++) {
 379	 boolean filled = appointmentService.processNextInWaitlist(id);
 380	 if (filled) {
 381	 filledCount++;
 382	 } else {
 383	 // 候补队列已空，无需继续
 384	 break;
 385	 }
 386	 }
 387	
 388	 // 4. 准备返回结果
 389	 Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
 390	 result.put("schedule", scheduleMapper.selectById(id)); // 返回最新的排班信息
 391	 result.put("filledFromWaitlist", filledCount);
 392	 result.put("message", String.format("成功增加 %d 个号源，并自动为 %d 位候补患者创建了预约。", slotsToAdd, filledCount));
 393	
 394	 return result;
 395	 }
